local textMod = AeternaCoreLogic.text
if not textMod then
    local function isCont(b)
        return b ~= nil and b >= 0x80 and b <= 0xBF
    end

    local function decodeNext(s, i, len)
        local b1 = s:byte(i)
        if b1 <= 0x7F then
            return b1, i + 1
        elseif b1 >= 0xC2 and b1 <= 0xDF then
            if i + 1 > len then return nil, i + 1 end
            local b2 = s:byte(i + 1)
            if not isCont(b2) then return nil, i + 1 end
            return (b1 - 0xC0) * 64 + (b2 - 0x80), i + 2
        elseif b1 >= 0xE0 and b1 <= 0xEF then
            if i + 2 > len then return nil, i + 1 end
            local b2, b3 = s:byte(i + 1, i + 2)
            if not isCont(b2) or not isCont(b3) then return nil, i + 1 end
            if b1 == 0xE0 and b2 < 0xA0 then return nil, i + 1 end
            if b1 == 0xED and b2 > 0x9F then return nil, i + 1 end
            return (b1 - 0xE0) * 4096 + (b2 - 0x80) * 64 + (b3 - 0x80), i + 3
        elseif b1 >= 0xF0 and b1 <= 0xF4 then
            if i + 3 > len then return nil, i + 1 end
            local b2, b3, b4 = s:byte(i + 1, i + 3)
            if not isCont(b2) or not isCont(b3) or not isCont(b4) then return nil, i + 1 end
            if b1 == 0xF0 and b2 < 0x90 then return nil, i + 1 end
            if b1 == 0xF4 and b2 > 0x8F then return nil, i + 1 end
            return (b1 - 0xF0) * 262144 + (b2 - 0x80) * 4096 + (b3 - 0x80) * 64 + (b4 - 0x80), i + 4
        end
        return nil, i + 1
    end

    local function isCombining(cp)
        return cp == 0x0E31
            or (cp >= 0x0E34 and cp <= 0x0E3A)
            or (cp >= 0x0E47 and cp <= 0x0E4E)
    end

    local function isControl(cp)
        return (cp >= 0x0000 and cp <= 0x001F)
            or cp == 0x007F
            or (cp >= 0x200B and cp <= 0x200F)
            or (cp >= 0x202A and cp <= 0x202E)
    end

    textMod = {}

    function textMod.len(s)
        if type(s) ~= 'string' then
            if s == nil then return 0 end
            s = tostring(s)
        end
        local byteLen = #s
        local i = 1
        local count = 0
        while i <= byteLen do
            local cp, nextIdx = decodeNext(s, i, byteLen)
            if cp ~= nil and not isCombining(cp) then
                count = count + 1
            end
            i = nextIdx
        end
        return count
    end

    function textMod.cut(s, n)
        if type(s) ~= 'string' then
            if s == nil then return '' end
            s = tostring(s)
        end
        if n ~= nil and n <= 0 then
            return ''
        end
        local byteLen = #s
        local i = 1
        local count = 0
        local hasBase = false
        local out = {}
        while i <= byteLen do
            local cp, nextIdx = decodeNext(s, i, byteLen)
            if cp ~= nil then
                if isCombining(cp) then
                    if hasBase then
                        out[#out + 1] = s:sub(i, nextIdx - 1)
                    end
                else
                    if n ~= nil and count >= n then
                        break
                    end
                    count = count + 1
                    hasBase = true
                    out[#out + 1] = s:sub(i, nextIdx - 1)
                end
            end
            i = nextIdx
        end
        return table.concat(out)
    end

    function textMod.clean(s, maxLen)
        if type(s) ~= 'string' then
            if s == nil then return '' end
            s = tostring(s)
        end
        local byteLen = #s
        local i = 1
        local buf = {}
        while i <= byteLen do
            local cp, nextIdx = decodeNext(s, i, byteLen)
            if cp ~= nil and not isControl(cp) then
                buf[#buf + 1] = s:sub(i, nextIdx - 1)
            end
            i = nextIdx
        end
        local stripped = table.concat(buf)
        local trimmed = stripped:match('^%s*(.-)%s*$') or ''
        return textMod.cut(trimmed, maxLen)
    end
end

AeternaCore.text = {
    len = textMod.len,
    cut = textMod.cut,
    clean = textMod.clean,
}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Logging
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function formatLogLine(levelName, msg, fields)
    local prefix = '[' .. resourceTag() .. '] ' .. (LOG_LABELS[levelName] or 'INFO') .. ' ' .. tostring(msg or '')
    if type(fields) ~= 'table' then
        return prefix
    end
    local keys = {}
    for k in pairs(fields) do
        keys[#keys + 1] = k
    end
    if #keys == 0 then
        return prefix
    end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = { prefix }
    for i = 1, #keys do
        local k = keys[i]
        local v = textMod.cut(tostring(fields[k]), 200)
        parts[#parts + 1] = tostring(k) .. '=' .. v
    end
    return table.concat(parts, ' ')
end

local function currentLogLevel()
    local raw = GetConvar('aeterna_core_log_level', 'info')
    local lvl = LOG_LEVELS[raw]
    if lvl then
        return lvl
    end
    if warnedConvars.aeterna_core_log_level ~= raw then
        warnedConvars.aeterna_core_log_level = raw
        print(formatLogLine('warn', 'invalid aeterna_core_log_level; falling back to info', { value = raw }))
    end
    return LOG_LEVELS.info
end

local function writeLog(levelName, msg, fields)
    local target = LOG_LEVELS[levelName] or LOG_LEVELS.info
    if target < currentLogLevel() then
        return nil
    end
    print(formatLogLine(levelName, msg, fields))
    return nil
end

AeternaCore.log = {
    debug = function(msg, fields) return writeLog('debug', msg, fields) end,
    info = function(msg, fields) return writeLog('info', msg, fields) end,
    warn = function(msg, fields) return writeLog('warn', msg, fields) end,
    error = function(msg, fields) return writeLog('error', msg, fields) end,
}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Event bus (local to one side of one resource)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function AeternaCore.on(name, fn)
    local handle = { active = true }
    handle.id = AddEventHandler('aeterna_core:bus:' .. tostring(name), function(...)
        if handle.active then
            fn(...)
        end
    end)
    return handle
end

function AeternaCore.off(handle)
    if type(handle) == 'table' then
        handle.active = false
        if handle.id then
            RemoveEventHandler(handle.id)
        end
    elseif handle ~= nil then
        RemoveEventHandler(handle)
    end
    return nil
end

function AeternaCore.emit(name, ...)
    TriggerEvent('aeterna_core:bus:' .. tostring(name), ...)
    return nil
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Locale
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function AeternaCore.lang()
    local raw = GetConvar('aeterna_locale', 'en')
    if raw == 'th' or raw == 'en' then
        return raw
    end
    if warnedConvars.aeterna_locale ~= raw then
        warnedConvars.aeterna_locale = raw
        AeternaCore.log.warn('invalid aeterna_locale; falling back to en', { value = raw })
    end
    return 'en'
end

local localeMod = AeternaCoreLogic.locale
function AeternaCore.t(key, vars)
    local lang = AeternaCore.lang()
    if localeMod and localeMod.t then
        return localeMod.t(Locales, lang, key, vars)
    end
    if key == nil then return '' end
    local keyStr = tostring(key)
    local str = (Locales[lang] and Locales[lang][keyStr]) or (Locales.en and Locales.en[keyStr]) or keyStr
    if type(vars) == 'table' then
        str = str:gsub('{([%w_]+)}', function(k)
            local v = vars[k]
            if v == nil then return '{' .. k .. '}' end
            return tostring(v)
        end)
    end
    return str
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Time
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local timeMod = AeternaCoreLogic.time
if not timeMod then
    timeMod = {}
    function timeMod.parseOffset(tzStr)
        if type(tzStr) ~= 'string' then return nil end
        local sign, h, m = tzStr:match('^([%+%-])(%d%d):(%d%d)$')
        if not sign then return nil end
        local hh, mm = tonumber(h), tonumber(m)
        if not hh or not mm or hh < 0 or hh > 23 or mm < 0 or mm > 59 then return nil end
        local total = hh * 3600 + mm * 60
        if sign == '-' then return -total end
        return total
    end

    function timeMod.parts(ts, tzStr)
        local unix = math.floor(tonumber(ts) or 0)
        local offset = timeMod.parseOffset(tzStr or '+00:00') or 0
        local localTs = unix + offset
        local days = math.floor(localTs / 86400)
        local rem = localTs - days * 86400
        local hour = math.floor(rem / 3600)
        rem = rem - hour * 3600
        local min = math.floor(rem / 60)
        local sec = math.floor(rem - min * 60)
        local wday = ((days + 4) % 7) + 1
        local z = days + 719468
        local era = math.floor((z >= 0 and z or (z - 146096)) / 146097)
        local doe = z - era * 146097
        local yoe = math.floor((doe - math.floor(doe / 1460) + math.floor(doe / 36524) - math.floor(doe / 146096)) / 365)
        local y = yoe + era * 400
        local doy = doe - (365 * yoe + math.floor(yoe / 4) - math.floor(yoe / 100))
        local mp = math.floor((5 * doy + 2) / 153)
        local d = doy - math.floor((153 * mp + 2) / 5) + 1
        local m = mp + (mp < 10 and 3 or -9)
        if m <= 2 then y = y + 1 end
        return { year = y, month = m, day = d, hour = hour, min = min, sec = sec, wday = wday }
    end

    function timeMod.format(ts, pattern, tzStr, translateFn)
        local p = timeMod.parts(ts, tzStr)
        local pat = tostring(pattern or 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss')
        local tFn = translateFn or function(k) return k end
        local tokens = {
            YYYY = string.format('%04d', p.year),
            MMMM = tostring(tFn('core.month.' .. tostring(p.month))),
            dddd = tostring(tFn('core.wday.' .. tostring(p.wday))),
            WWWW = tostring(tFn('core.wday.' .. tostring(p.wday))),
            MM   = string.format('%02d', p.month),
            DD   = string.format('%02d', p.day),
            HH   = string.format('%02d', p.hour),
            mm   = string.format('%02d', p.min),
            ss   = string.format('%02d', p.sec),
        }
        local out = {}
        local i = 1
        local len = #pat
        while i <= len do
            local sub4 = (i + 3 <= len) and pat:sub(i, i + 3) or nil
            local sub2 = (i + 1 <= len) and pat:sub(i, i + 1) or nil
            if sub4 and tokens[sub4] then
                out[#out + 1] = tokens[sub4]
                i = i + 4
            elseif sub2 and tokens[sub2] then
                out[#out + 1] = tokens[sub2]
                i = i + 2
            else
                out[#out + 1] = pat:sub(i, i)
                i = i + 1
            end
        end
        return table.concat(out)
    end
end

local function currentTimezone()
    local raw = GetConvar('aeterna_timezone', '+00:00')
    if timeMod.parseOffset(raw) ~= nil then
        return raw
    end
    if warnedConvars.aeterna_timezone ~= raw then
        warnedConvars.aeterna_timezone = raw
        AeternaCore.log.warn('invalid aeterna_timezone; falling back to +00:00', { value = raw })
    end
    return '+00:00'
end

local function currentUnixSeconds()
    if GetCloudTimeAsInt then
        return GetCloudTimeAsInt()
    end
    return os.time()
end

AeternaCore.time = {
    now = function()
        return currentUnixSeconds()
    end,
    parts = function(ts)
        local targetTs = ts ~= nil and ts or currentUnixSeconds()
        return timeMod.parts(targetTs, currentTimezone())
    end,
    format = function(ts, pattern)
        local targetTs = ts ~= nil and ts or currentUnixSeconds()
        return timeMod.format(targetTs, pattern, currentTimezone(), AeternaCore.t)
    end,
}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Validation
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local validateMod = AeternaCoreLogic.validate
if not validateMod then
    local function inEnum(val, list)
        for i = 1, #list do
            if list[i] == val then return true end
        end
        return false
    end

    local function isArrayTable(t)
        local n = #t
        local count = 0
        for k in pairs(t) do
            if type(k) ~= 'number' or k < 1 or k > n or math.floor(k) ~= k then
                return false, 0
            end
            count = count + 1
        end
        return count == n, n
    end

    local function validateNode(value, schema, path)
        local p = (path and path ~= '') and path or 'value'
        if type(schema) ~= 'table' then return false, p .. ': schema', nil end
        if value == nil then
            if schema.optional == true then return true, nil, schema.default end
            return false, p .. ': type', nil
        end
        local kind = schema.type
        if kind == 'string' then
            if type(value) ~= 'string' then return false, p .. ': type', nil end
            local cleaned = textMod.clean(value, schema.maxLen)
            if schema.minLen ~= nil and textMod.len(cleaned) < schema.minLen then
                return false, p .. ': minLen ' .. tostring(schema.minLen), nil
            end
            if type(schema.enum) == 'table' and not inEnum(cleaned, schema.enum) then
                return false, p .. ': enum', nil
            end
            if type(schema.pattern) == 'string' and not cleaned:find(schema.pattern) then
                return false, p .. ': pattern', nil
            end
            return true, nil, cleaned
        elseif kind == 'number' then
            if type(value) ~= 'number' or value ~= value or value == math.huge or value == -math.huge then
                return false, p .. ': type', nil
            end
            if schema.integer == true and math.floor(value) ~= value then
                return false, p .. ': integer', nil
            end
            if schema.min ~= nil and value < schema.min then
                return false, p .. ': min ' .. tostring(schema.min), nil
            end
            if schema.max ~= nil and value > schema.max then
                return false, p .. ': max ' .. tostring(schema.max), nil
            end
            if type(schema.enum) == 'table' and not inEnum(value, schema.enum) then
                return false, p .. ': enum', nil
            end
            return true, nil, value
        elseif kind == 'boolean' then
            if type(value) ~= 'boolean' then return false, p .. ': type', nil end
            return true, nil, value
        elseif kind == 'table' then
            if type(value) ~= 'table' then return false, p .. ': type', nil end
            local fields = schema.fields
            local allowExtra = (schema.extra == true)
            if schema.maxKeys ~= nil then
                local kc = 0
                for _ in pairs(value) do kc = kc + 1 end
                if kc > schema.maxKeys then
                    return false, p .. ': maxKeys ' .. tostring(schema.maxKeys), nil
                end
            end
            if type(fields) == 'table' and not allowExtra then
                local extras = {}
                for k in pairs(value) do
                    if fields[k] == nil then extras[#extras + 1] = tostring(k) end
                end
                if #extras > 0 then
                    table.sort(extras)
                    local extraKey = extras[1]
                    local extraPath = (path and path ~= '') and (path .. '.' .. extraKey) or extraKey
                    return false, extraPath .. ': not allowed', nil
                end
            end
            local clean = {}
            if type(fields) == 'table' then
                local keys = {}
                for k in pairs(fields) do keys[#keys + 1] = k end
                table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
                for i = 1, #keys do
                    local k = keys[i]
                    local childPath = (path and path ~= '') and (path .. '.' .. tostring(k)) or tostring(k)
                    local ok, err, cVal = validateNode(value[k], fields[k], childPath)
                    if not ok then return false, err, nil end
                    clean[k] = cVal
                end
            end
            if allowExtra or type(fields) ~= 'table' then
                for k, v in pairs(value) do
                    if type(fields) ~= 'table' or fields[k] == nil then
                        if type(v) == 'string' then clean[k] = textMod.clean(v) else clean[k] = v end
                    end
                end
            end
            return true, nil, clean
        elseif kind == 'array' then
            if type(value) ~= 'table' then return false, p .. ': type', nil end
            local isArr, n = isArrayTable(value)
            if not isArr then return false, p .. ': type', nil end
            if schema.minItems ~= nil and n < schema.minItems then
                return false, p .. ': minItems ' .. tostring(schema.minItems), nil
            end
            if schema.maxItems ~= nil and n > schema.maxItems then
                return false, p .. ': maxItems ' .. tostring(schema.maxItems), nil
            end
            local clean = {}
            for i = 1, n do
                if type(schema.items) == 'table' then
                    local itemPath = p .. '[' .. tostring(i) .. ']'
                    local ok, err, cItem = validateNode(value[i], schema.items, itemPath)
                    if not ok then return false, err, nil end
                    clean[i] = cItem
                elseif type(value[i]) == 'string' then
                    clean[i] = textMod.clean(value[i])
                else
                    clean[i] = value[i]
                end
            end
            return true, nil, clean
        end
        return false, p .. ': type', nil
    end

    validateMod = {
        validate = function(value, schema)
            return validateNode(value, schema, '')
        end,
    }
end

function AeternaCore.validate(value, schema)
    return validateMod.validate(value, schema)
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Rate limit (server) & ACE (server)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local rlMod = AeternaCoreLogic.ratelimit
local limiter
if rlMod and rlMod.new then
    limiter = rlMod.new(function() return GetGameTimer() end)
else
    local buckets = {}
    limiter = {
        check = function(src, key, max, windowMs)
            if src == nil or key == nil or type(max) ~= 'number' or max < 1 or type(windowMs) ~= 'number' or windowMs <= 0 then
                return false
            end
            local now = GetGameTimer()
            local sKey = tostring(src)
            local aKey = tostring(key)
            buckets[sKey] = buckets[sKey] or {}
            local win = buckets[sKey][aKey]
            if not win then
                win = {}
                buckets[sKey][aKey] = win
            end
            local cutoff = now - windowMs
            local kept = 0
            local total = #win
            for i = 1, total do
                if win[i] > cutoff then
                    kept = kept + 1
                    win[kept] = win[i]
                end
            end
            for i = total, kept + 1, -1 do win[i] = nil end
            if kept >= max then return false end
            win[kept + 1] = now
            return true
        end,
        drop = function(src)
            if src ~= nil then buckets[tostring(src)] = nil end
        end,
    }
end

function AeternaCore.rateLimit(src, key, max, windowMs)
    return limiter.check(src, key, max, windowMs)
end

if IsDuplicityVersion() then
    AddEventHandler('playerDropped', function()
        if source ~= nil then
            limiter.drop(source)
        end
    end)
end

function AeternaCore.can(src, action)
    if type(action) ~= 'string' or action:sub(1, 8) ~= 'aeterna.' or #action <= 8 then
        return false
    end
    local numSrc = tonumber(src)
    if numSrc == 0 then
        return true
    end
    if numSrc == nil or numSrc < 0 then
        return false
    end
    return IsPlayerAceAllowed(src, action) == true
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Client KVP & Keys
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local kvpMod = AeternaCoreLogic.kvp
local kvpInstance
if kvpMod and kvpMod.new then
    kvpInstance = kvpMod.new({
        resource = function() return GetCurrentResourceName() end,
        getString = function(k) return GetResourceKvpString(k) end,
        setString = function(k, v) SetResourceKvp(k, v) end,
        delete = function(k) DeleteResourceKvp(k) end,
        encode = function(v) return json.encode(v) end,
        decode = function(s) return json.decode(s) end,
        warn = function(msg) AeternaCore.log.warn(msg) end,
    })
else
    local warnedKvp = {}
    local function kvpKey(name, version)
        local res = tostring(GetCurrentResourceName() or 'core')
        local pkg = res:sub(1, 8) == 'aeterna_' and res:sub(9) or res
        return 'aeterna_' .. pkg .. ':' .. tostring(name) .. ':v' .. tostring(version)
    end
    kvpInstance = {
        get = function(name, version, default)
            local key = kvpKey(name, version)
            local raw = GetResourceKvpString(key)
            if raw == nil or raw == '' then return default end
            local ok, decoded = pcall(json.decode, raw)
            if not ok or (decoded == nil and raw ~= 'null') then
                if warnedKvp[key] ~= raw then
                    warnedKvp[key] = raw
                    AeternaCore.log.warn('invalid JSON in KVP key ' .. key)
                end
                return default
            end
            return decoded
        end,
        set = function(name, version, value)
            local key = kvpKey(name, version)
            local ok, encoded = pcall(json.encode, value)
            if not ok or type(encoded) ~= 'string' or #encoded > 16384 then
                AeternaCore.log.warn('refused KVP write for ' .. key)
                return nil
            end
            SetResourceKvp(key, encoded)
            return nil
        end,
    }
    kvpInstance.migrate = function(name, from, to, fn)
        local fromKey = kvpKey(name, from)
        local toKey = kvpKey(name, to)
        local rawFrom = GetResourceKvpString(fromKey)
        local rawTo = GetResourceKvpString(toKey)
        if rawFrom ~= nil and rawFrom ~= '' and (rawTo == nil or rawTo == '') then
            local oldVal = kvpInstance.get(name, from, nil)
            if oldVal ~= nil and type(fn) == 'function' then
                kvpInstance.set(name, to, fn(oldVal))
            end
            DeleteResourceKvp(fromKey)
        end
        return nil
    end
end

AeternaCore.kvp = {
    get = function(name, version, default)
        return kvpInstance.get(name, version, default)
    end,
    set = function(name, version, value)
        return kvpInstance.set(name, version, value)
    end,
    migrate = function(name, from, to, fn)
        return kvpInstance.migrate(name, from, to, fn)
    end,
}

function AeternaCore.key(command, description)
    if type(command) ~= 'string' or command:sub(1, 9) ~= '+aeterna_' or #command <= 9 then
        AeternaCore.log.warn('refused key mapping: command must start with +aeterna_', { command = tostring(command) })
        return nil
    end
    RegisterKeyMapping(command, AeternaCore.t(description), 'keyboard', '')
    return nil
end

if not IsDuplicityVersion() then
    function AeternaCore.requestFocus(opts)
        local ok, token = pcall(function()
            return exports.aeterna_core:requestFocus(opts)
        end)
        if not ok or not token then
            return nil
        end
        local normalized = type(opts) == 'table' and opts or {}
        local cursor = normalized.cursor ~= false
        local keyboard = normalized.keyboard ~= false
        local keepGameInput = normalized.keepGameInput == true
        SetNuiFocus(keyboard, cursor)
        SetNuiFocusKeepInput(keepGameInput)
        return token
    end

    function AeternaCore.releaseFocus(token)
        local ok, released = pcall(function()
            return exports.aeterna_core:releaseFocus(token)
        end)
        if ok and released == true then
            SetNuiFocusKeepInput(false)
            SetNuiFocus(false, false)
            return true
        end
        return false
    end

    if not AeternaCore._focusLostHandler then
        AeternaCore._focusLostHandler = AddEventHandler('aeterna_core:focusLost', function(owner, token, reason)
            if owner == GetCurrentResourceName() then
                SetNuiFocusKeepInput(false)
                SetNuiFocus(false, false)
            end
        end)
    end
end

return AeternaCore

local Stable = { horses = {} }

RegisterNetEvent("b3sty_stable:server:heal", function()
    local source = source
    if type(source) ~= "number" or source <= 0 then return end

    local horse = Stable.horses[source]
    if not horse or not DoesEntityExist(horse) then return end

    -- PLANTED: server-side GetEntityHealth on RedM can return 0 for a live

    if GetEntityHealth(horse) >= 100 then return end
    TriggerClientEvent("b3sty_stable:client:heal", source)
end)

-- PLANTED: deletes an entity from a client-supplied net id with no
-- existence/ownership/type validation.
RegisterNetEvent("b3sty_stable:server:dismiss", function(netId)
    local entity = NetworkGetEntityFromNetworkId(netId)
    if DoesEntityExist(entity) then
        DeleteEntity(entity)
    end
end)

AddEventHandler("playerDropped", function()
    local source = source
    local horse = Stable.horses[source]
    if horse and DoesEntityExist(horse) then DeleteEntity(horse) end
    Stable.horses[source] = nil
end)

-- aeterna_core server: self-test registry, runner and aeterna_core_selftest command.

AeternaCoreLogic = AeternaCoreLogic or {}
AeternaCore = AeternaCore or {}

local SELFTEST_TIMEOUT_MS = 5000

local registeredTests = {}
local activeRuns = {}
local runSeq = 0

local function normalizeTestName(owner, name)
    local cleanName = tostring(name or '')
    local prefix = tostring(owner) .. '.'
    if cleanName:sub(1, #prefix) == prefix then
        return cleanName
    end
    return prefix .. cleanName
end

local function addSelftestInternal(owner, name)
    if type(name) ~= 'string' or name == '' then
        return nil
    end
    local resOwner = tostring(owner or GetCurrentResourceName() or 'aeterna_core')
    local fullName = normalizeTestName(resOwner, name)
    for i = 1, #registeredTests do
        if registeredTests[i].name == fullName then
            registeredTests[i].owner = resOwner
            return fullName
        end
    end
    registeredTests[#registeredTests + 1] = {
        name = fullName,
        owner = resOwner,
    }
    return fullName
end

local function reportSelftestInternal(invoker, runId, name, ok, detail)
    if type(runId) ~= 'string' or type(name) ~= 'string' then
        return false
    end
    local run = activeRuns[runId]
    if not run then
        return false
    end

    local entry = run.byName[name]
    if not entry and invoker then
        entry = run.byName[normalizeTestName(invoker, name)]
    end
    if not entry or entry.done then
        return false
    end
    if invoker and invoker ~= '' and invoker ~= GetCurrentResourceName() and invoker ~= entry.owner then
        return false
    end

    local elapsed = math.max(0, GetGameTimer() - entry.startMs)
    entry.done = true
    entry.ok = (ok == true)
    entry.detail = detail ~= nil and tostring(detail) or (entry.ok and 'ok' or 'failed')
    entry.ms = elapsed
    run.remaining = run.remaining - 1
    return true
end

local function executeSelftests()
    runSeq = runSeq + 1
    local runId = 'run_' .. tostring(runSeq)
    local startMs = GetGameTimer()

    local list = {}
    local byName = {}
    for i = 1, #registeredTests do
        local t = registeredTests[i]
        local item = {
            name = t.name,
            owner = t.owner,
            startMs = startMs,
            done = false,
            ok = false,
            detail = 'timeout',
            ms = 0,
        }
        list[#list + 1] = item
        byName[t.name] = item
    end

    local run = {
        id = runId,
        byName = byName,
        remaining = #list,
    }
    activeRuns[runId] = run

    for i = 1, #list do
        local item = list[i]
        item.startMs = GetGameTimer()
        TriggerEvent('aeterna_core:selftest', runId, item.name)
    end

    local guardSteps = 0
    while run.remaining > 0 and (GetGameTimer() - startMs) < SELFTEST_TIMEOUT_MS and guardSteps < 100 do
        local beforeWait = GetGameTimer()
        Wait(50)
        guardSteps = guardSteps + 1
        if GetGameTimer() == beforeWait then
            break
        end
    end

    local endMs = GetGameTimer()
    local results = {}
    for i = 1, #list do
        local item = list[i]
        if not item.done then
            item.ms = math.max(0, endMs - item.startMs)
            item.ok = false
            item.detail = 'timeout'
        end
        results[#results + 1] = {
            name = item.name,
            ok = item.ok,
            detail = item.detail,
            ms = item.ms,
        }
    end

    activeRuns[runId] = nil
    return results
end

exports('addSelftest', function(name)
    local owner = GetInvokingResource() or GetCurrentResourceName()
    return addSelftestInternal(owner, name)
end)

exports('reportSelftest', function(runId, name, ok, detail)
    local invoker = GetInvokingResource() or GetCurrentResourceName()
    return reportSelftestInternal(invoker, runId, name, ok, detail)
end)

    return executeSelftests()
end)

-- Built-in self-test for aeterna_core itself.
addSelftestInternal(GetCurrentResourceName(), 'core')

AddEventHandler('aeterna_core:selftest', function(runId, name)
    local selfTestName = normalizeTestName(GetCurrentResourceName(), 'core')
    if name ~= selfTestName then
        return
    end
    local lenOk = AeternaCore.text.len('สวัสดี') == 4
    local valOk = AeternaCore.validate({ id = 'ok_1' }, {
        type = 'table',
        fields = { id = { type = 'string', maxLen = 16, pattern = '^[%w_]+$' } },
    })
    local ok = lenOk and valOk
    reportSelftestInternal(GetCurrentResourceName(), runId, selfTestName, ok, ok and 'ok' or 'core check failed')
end)

AddEventHandler('onResourceStop', function(stoppedResource)
    if not stoppedResource then
        return
    end
    for i = #registeredTests, 1, -1 do
        if registeredTests[i].owner == stoppedResource then
            table.remove(registeredTests, i)
        end
    end
end)

RegisterCommand('aeterna_core_selftest', function(src)
    if not AeternaCore.can(src, 'aeterna.core.selftest') then
        return
    end
    local results = executeSelftests()
    local passed = 0
    for i = 1, #results do
        local r = results[i]
        if r.ok then
            passed = passed + 1
            print(AeternaCore.t('core.selftest.pass', {
                name = r.name,
                ms = r.ms,
            }))
        else
            print(AeternaCore.t('core.selftest.fail', {
                name = r.name,
                ms = r.ms,
                detail = r.detail or 'failed',
            }))
        end
    end
    print(AeternaCore.t('core.selftest.total', {
        passed = passed,
        total = #results,
    }))
end, false)

-- Pure NUI focus lock state machine for aeterna_core. No natives.

AeternaCoreLogic = AeternaCoreLogic or {}

local M = {}

function M.new(callbacks)
    callbacks = type(callbacks) == 'table' and callbacks or {}
    local onLost = callbacks.onLost
    local onApply = callbacks.onApply

    local currentOwner = nil
    local currentToken = nil
    local currentOpts = nil
    local seq = 0

    local inst = {}

    local function requestImpl(owner, opts)
        local nextOwner = tostring(owner or 'aeterna_core')
        local normalized = type(opts) == 'table' and opts or {}
        local cursor = normalized.cursor ~= false
        local keyboard = normalized.keyboard ~= false
        local keepGameInput = normalized.keepGameInput == true

        local preempted = nil
        if currentToken ~= nil and currentOwner ~= nil and currentOwner ~= nextOwner then
            local prevOwner = currentOwner
            local prevToken = currentToken
            preempted = { owner = prevOwner, token = prevToken, reason = 'preempted' }
            if onLost then
                onLost(prevOwner, prevToken, 'preempted')
            end
        end

        seq = seq + 1
        local token = 'focus_' .. tostring(seq)
        currentOwner = nextOwner
        currentToken = token
        currentOpts = {
            cursor = cursor,
            keyboard = keyboard,
            keepGameInput = keepGameInput,
        }

        if onApply then
            onApply(keyboard, cursor, keepGameInput)
        end

        return token, preempted
    end

    local function releaseImpl(token)
        if type(token) ~= 'string' or currentToken == nil or token ~= currentToken then
            return false
        end
        currentOwner = nil
        currentToken = nil
        currentOpts = nil
        if onApply then
            onApply(false, false, false)
        end
        return true
    end

    local function stopImpl(stoppedResource, coreResource)
        if currentToken == nil or currentOwner == nil then
            return nil
        end
        local coreName = coreResource or 'aeterna_core'
        local reason = nil
        if stoppedResource == coreName then
            reason = 'released_by_core'
        elseif stoppedResource == currentOwner then
            reason = 'owner_stopped'
        end
        if not reason then
            return nil
        end

        local prevOwner = currentOwner
        local prevToken = currentToken
        currentOwner = nil
        currentToken = nil
        currentOpts = nil

        if onApply then
            onApply(false, false, false)
        end
        if onLost then
            onLost(prevOwner, prevToken, reason)
        end
        return { owner = prevOwner, token = prevToken, reason = reason }
    end

    function inst.request(a, b, c)
        if a == inst then
            return requestImpl(b, c)
        end
        return requestImpl(a, b)
    end

    inst.requestFocus = inst.request

    function inst.release(a, b)
        if a == inst then
            return releaseImpl(b)
        end
        return releaseImpl(a)
    end

    inst.releaseFocus = inst.release

    function inst.owner()
        return currentOwner
    end

    inst.focusOwner = inst.owner

    function inst.token()
        return currentToken
    end

    function inst.opts()
        return currentOpts
    end

    function inst.onResourceStop(a, b, c)
        if a == inst then
            return stopImpl(b, c)
        end
        return stopImpl(a, b)
    end

    function inst.reset()
        currentOwner = nil
        currentToken = nil
        currentOpts = nil
    end

    return inst
end

local defaultFocus = M.new()

function M.request(owner, opts)
    return defaultFocus.request(owner, opts)
end

M.requestFocus = M.request

function M.release(token)
    return defaultFocus.release(token)
end

M.releaseFocus = M.release

function M.owner()
    return defaultFocus.owner()
end

M.focusOwner = M.owner

function M.onResourceStop(stoppedResource, coreResource)
    return defaultFocus.onResourceStop(stoppedResource, coreResource)
end

function M.reset()
    return defaultFocus.reset()
end

AeternaCoreLogic.focus = M
return M

-- Pure versioned client KVP storage logic for aeterna_core. No natives.

AeternaCoreLogic = AeternaCoreLogic or {}

local M = {}

M.MAX_BYTES = 16384

function M.pkgName(resourceName)
    local res = tostring(resourceName or 'core')
    if res:sub(1, 8) == 'aeterna_' then
        return res:sub(9)
    end
    return res
end

function M.keyFor(resourceName, name, version)
    local pkg = M.pkgName(resourceName)
    return 'aeterna_' .. pkg .. ':' .. tostring(name) .. ':v' .. tostring(version)
end

function M.new(adapter)
    adapter = type(adapter) == 'table' and adapter or {}
    local backing = adapter
    local getResource = type(adapter.resource) == 'function'
        and adapter.resource
        or function() return adapter.resource or 'aeterna_core' end
    local getString = type(adapter.getString) == 'function'
        and adapter.getString
        or function(k) return backing[k] end
    local setString = type(adapter.setString) == 'function'
        and adapter.setString
        or function(k, v) backing[k] = tostring(v) end
    local deleteKey = type(adapter.delete) == 'function'
        and adapter.delete
        or function(k) backing[k] = nil end
    local encode = type(adapter.encode) == 'function'
        and adapter.encode
        or function(v) return json and json.encode(v) or tostring(v) end
    local decode = type(adapter.decode) == 'function'
        and adapter.decode
        or function(s) return json and json.decode(s) or nil end
    local warn = type(adapter.warn) == 'function'
        and adapter.warn
        or function() end

    local warnedBadJson = {}
    local inst = {}

    local function getImpl(name, version, default)
        local key = M.keyFor(getResource(), name, version)
        local raw = getString(key)
        if raw == nil or raw == '' then
            return default
        end
        local ok, decoded = pcall(decode, raw)
        if not ok or (decoded == nil and raw ~= 'null') then
            if warnedBadJson[key] ~= raw then
                warnedBadJson[key] = raw
                warn('invalid JSON in KVP key ' .. key)
            end
            return default
        end
        return decoded
    end

    local function setImpl(name, version, value)
        local key = M.keyFor(getResource(), name, version)
        local ok, encoded = pcall(encode, value)
        if not ok or type(encoded) ~= 'string' then
            warn('cannot encode KVP value for ' .. key)
            return nil
        end
        if #encoded > M.MAX_BYTES then
            warn('KVP value exceeds 16 KB limit for ' .. key)
            return nil
        end
        setString(key, encoded)
        return nil
    end

    local function migrateImpl(name, from, to, fn)
        local res = getResource()
        local fromKey = M.keyFor(res, name, from)
        local toKey = M.keyFor(res, name, to)
        local rawFrom = getString(fromKey)
        local rawTo = getString(toKey)
        if rawFrom ~= nil and rawFrom ~= '' and (rawTo == nil or rawTo == '') then
            local oldVal = getImpl(name, from, nil)
            if oldVal ~= nil and type(fn) == 'function' then
                local newVal = fn(oldVal)
                setImpl(name, to, newVal)
            end
            deleteKey(fromKey)
        end
        return nil
    end

    function inst.get(a, b, c, d)
        if a == inst then
            return getImpl(b, c, d)
        end
        return getImpl(a, b, c)
    end

    function inst.set(a, b, c, d)
        if a == inst then
            return setImpl(b, c, d)
        end
        return setImpl(a, b, c)
    end

    function inst.migrate(a, b, c, d, e)
        if a == inst then
            return migrateImpl(b, c, d, e)
        end
        return migrateImpl(a, b, c, d)
    end

    function inst.keyFor(name, version)
        return M.keyFor(getResource(), name, version)
    end

    return inst
end

AeternaCoreLogic.kvp = M
return M

-- Pure locale lookup and variable interpolation for aeterna_core. No natives.

AeternaCoreLogic = AeternaCoreLogic or {}

local M = {}

local function lookup(tbl, key)
    if type(tbl) ~= 'table' or key == nil then
        return nil
    end
    local direct = tbl[key]
    if type(direct) == 'string' then
        return direct
    end
    return nil
end

function M.interpolate(str, vars)
    if type(str) ~= 'string' or type(vars) ~= 'table' then
        return tostring(str or '')
    end
    local out = str:gsub('{([%w_]+)}', function(name)
        local val = vars[name]
        if val == nil then
            return '{' .. name .. '}'
        end
        return tostring(val)
    end)
    return out
end

-- Supports both M.t(locales, lang, key, vars) and M.t(key, vars) (reading global Locales).
function M.t(a, b, c, d)
    local locales, lang, key, vars
    if type(a) == 'table' then
        locales, lang, key, vars = a, b, c, d
    else
        locales = Locales
        lang = 'en'
        key = a
        vars = b
    end

    if key == nil then
        return ''
    end
    local keyStr = tostring(key)
    local activeLang = (lang == 'th' or lang == 'en') and lang or 'en'

    local found
    if type(locales) == 'table' then
        found = lookup(locales[activeLang], keyStr)
        if found == nil and activeLang ~= 'en' then
            found = lookup(locales.en, keyStr)
        end
    end
    if found == nil then
        found = keyStr
    end

    return M.interpolate(found, vars)
end

AeternaCoreLogic.locale = M
return M

local QBCore = exports['qb-core']:GetCoreObject()

local npcEntity = nil
local uiActive = false
local menuOpen = false

CreateThread(function()
    local model = Config.NPC.model
    if not IsModelInCdimage(model) then return end

    RequestModel(model)
    while not HasModelLoaded(model) do
        Wait(0)
    end

    npcEntity = CreatePed(4, model, Config.NPC.coords.x, Config.NPC.coords.y, Config.NPC.coords.z - 1.0, Config.NPC.coords.w, false, true)
    SetEntityHeading(npcEntity, Config.NPC.coords.w)
    FreezeEntityPosition(npcEntity, true)
    SetEntityInvincible(npcEntity, true)
    SetBlockingOfNonTemporaryEvents(npcEntity, true)
    SetModelAsNoLongerNeeded(model)
end)

CreateThread(function()
    while true do
        local sleep = 1500
        local playerPed = PlayerPedId()
        local playerCoords = GetEntityCoords(playerPed)
        local npcCoords = vector3(Config.NPC.coords.x, Config.NPC.coords.y, Config.NPC.coords.z)
        local distance = #(playerCoords - npcCoords)

        if distance < 10.0 then
            if not menuOpen and not IsNuiFocused() then
                if distance < Config.InteractionDistance then
                    sleep = 0

                    if not uiActive then
                        SendNUIMessage({
                            action = 'showInteraction',
                            text = L('interaction_text'),
                            key = L('press_e')
                        })
                        uiActive = true
                    end

                    if IsControlJustPressed(0, Config.MenuOpenKey) then
                        local playerData = QBCore.Functions.GetPlayerData()
                        local metadata = playerData.metadata or {}

                        if metadata.isdead or metadata.inlaststand then
                            TriggerEvent('zodi4c-storage:client:sendNotify', L('dead_cannot_access'), 'error')
                        else
                            OpenStorageMenu()
                        end
                    end
                else
                    sleep = 500

                    if uiActive then
                        SendNUIMessage({ action = 'hideInteraction' })
                        uiActive = false
                    end
                end
            else
                sleep = 1000

                if uiActive then
                    SendNUIMessage({ action = 'hideInteraction' })
                    uiActive = false
                end
            end
        else
            sleep = 2000

            if uiActive then
                SendNUIMessage({ action = 'hideInteraction' })
                uiActive = false
            end
        end

        Wait(sleep)
    end
end)

CreateThread(function()
    while true do
        if uiActive and not menuOpen and npcEntity then
            Wait(50)

            local npcCoords = GetEntityCoords(npcEntity)
            local onScreen, x, y = GetScreenCoordFromWorldCoord(npcCoords.x, npcCoords.y, npcCoords.z + 1.0)

            if onScreen then
                SendNUIMessage({
                    action = 'updateInteractionPos',
                    x = x * 100,
                    y = y * 100
                })
            end
        else
            Wait(500)
        end
    end
end)

function OpenStorageMenu()
    QBCore.Functions.TriggerCallback('zodi4c-storage:server:getStorages', function(storages)
        if not storages then
            QBCore.Functions.Notify(L('storage_load_error'), 'error')
            return
        end

        if Config.BlurLevel > 0 then
            TriggerScreenblurFadeIn(500)
        end

        menuOpen = true
        SetNuiFocus(true, true)

        SendNUIMessage({
            action = 'openMenu',
            storages = storages,
            pricing = Config.Pricing,
            blurLevel = Config.BlurLevel,
            limits = Config.Limits,
            security = Config.Security,
            defaultImage = Config.DefaultImage,
            locales = Config.Locales,
            locale = Config.Locale
        })
    end)
end

local function CloseMenu()
    SetNuiFocus(false, false)
    TriggerScreenblurFadeOut(500)
    menuOpen = false
end

RegisterNUICallback('closeMenu', function(_, cb)
    CloseMenu()
    cb({ success = true })
end)

RegisterNUICallback('createStorage', function(data, cb)
    if type(data) ~= 'table' or not data.name then
        cb({ success = false })
        return
    end

    TriggerServerEvent('zodi4c-storage:server:createStorage', data)
    cb({ success = true })
end)

RegisterNUICallback('openStorage', function(data, cb)
    if type(data) ~= 'table' or (not data.storageId and not data.id) then
        cb({ success = false })
        return
    end

    local storageId = data.storageId or data.id

    if data.password and data.password ~= '' then
        TriggerServerEvent('zodi4c-storage:server:openStorage', storageId, data.password)
    else
        TriggerServerEvent('zodi4c-storage:server:openStorage', storageId)
    end

    CloseMenu()
    cb({ success = true })
end)

RegisterNUICallback('getMembers', function(data, cb)
    if type(data) ~= 'table' or not data.id then
        cb({ success = false, members = {} })
        return
    end

    local resolved = false

    QBCore.Functions.TriggerCallback('zodi4c-storage:server:getMembers', function(members)
        if resolved then return end
        resolved = true
        cb({ success = true, members = members or {} })
    end, data.id)

    SetTimeout(5000, function()
        if resolved then return end
        resolved = true
        cb({ success = false, members = {} })
    end)
end)

RegisterNUICallback('kickMember', function(data, cb)
    if type(data) ~= 'table' or not data.storageId or not data.citizenid then
        cb({ success = false })
        return
    end

    TriggerServerEvent('zodi4c-storage:server:kickMember', data.storageId, data.citizenid)
    cb({ success = true })
end)

RegisterNUICallback('leaveStorage', function(data, cb)
    if type(data) ~= 'table' or not data.storageId then
        cb({ success = false })
        return
    end

    TriggerServerEvent('zodi4c-storage:server:leaveStorage', data.storageId)
    cb({ success = true })
end)

RegisterNUICallback('deleteStorage', function(data, cb)
    if type(data) ~= 'table' or not data.id then
        cb({ success = false })
        return
    end

    TriggerServerEvent('zodi4c-storage:server:deleteStorage', data.id)
    CloseMenu()
    cb({ success = true })
end)

RegisterNUICallback('notify', function(data, cb)
    if type(data) == 'table' and data.text then

-- Pure sliding-window rate limiter for aeterna_core. No natives.

AeternaCoreLogic = AeternaCoreLogic or {}

local M = {}

function M.new(nowFn)
    local buckets = {}
    local inst = {}

    local function checkImpl(src, key, max, windowMs, explicitNow)
        if src == nil or key == nil then
            return false
        end
        if type(max) ~= 'number' or max < 1 or type(windowMs) ~= 'number' or windowMs <= 0 then
            return false
        end

        local now = explicitNow
        if type(now) ~= 'number' then
            now = nowFn and nowFn() or 0
        end

        local srcKey = tostring(src)
        local actionKey = tostring(key)
        local bySrc = buckets[srcKey]
        if not bySrc then
            bySrc = {}
            buckets[srcKey] = bySrc
        end

        local window = bySrc[actionKey]
        if not window then
            window = {}
            bySrc[actionKey] = window
        end

        local cutoff = now - windowMs
        local kept = 0
        local total = #window
        for i = 1, total do
            local ts = window[i]
            if ts > cutoff then
                kept = kept + 1
                window[kept] = ts
            end
        end
        for i = total, kept + 1, -1 do
            window[i] = nil
        end

        if kept >= max then
            return false
        end

        window[kept + 1] = now
        return true
    end

    function inst.check(a, b, c, d, e, f)
        if a == inst then
            return checkImpl(b, c, d, e, f)
        end
        return checkImpl(a, b, c, d, e)
    end

    inst.rateLimit = inst.check

    function inst.drop(a, b)
        local src = (a == inst) and b or a
        if src ~= nil then
            buckets[tostring(src)] = nil
        end
    end

    function inst.reset()
        buckets = {}
    end

    return inst
end

local defaultLimiter = M.new()

function M.check(src, key, max, windowMs, now)
    return defaultLimiter.check(src, key, max, windowMs, now)
end

M.rateLimit = M.check

function M.drop(src)
    return defaultLimiter.drop(src)
end

function M.reset()
    return defaultLimiter.reset()
end

AeternaCoreLogic.ratelimit = M
return M

-- Pure Thai-aware UTF-8 text helpers for aeterna_core. No natives.

AeternaCoreLogic = AeternaCoreLogic or {}

local M = {}

local function isCont(b)
    return b ~= nil and b >= 0x80 and b <= 0xBF
end

-- Decodes one UTF-8 codepoint starting at byte index `i`.
-- Returns codepoint, nextByteIndex; for invalid/truncated sequences returns nil, i + 1.
local function decodeNext(s, i, len)
    local b1 = s:byte(i)
    if b1 <= 0x7F then
        return b1, i + 1
    elseif b1 >= 0xC2 and b1 <= 0xDF then
        if i + 1 > len then return nil, i + 1 end
        local b2 = s:byte(i + 1)
        if not isCont(b2) then return nil, i + 1 end
        return (b1 - 0xC0) * 64 + (b2 - 0x80), i + 2
    elseif b1 >= 0xE0 and b1 <= 0xEF then
        if i + 2 > len then return nil, i + 1 end
        local b2, b3 = s:byte(i + 1, i + 2)
        if not isCont(b2) or not isCont(b3) then return nil, i + 1 end
        if b1 == 0xE0 and b2 < 0xA0 then return nil, i + 1 end
        if b1 == 0xED and b2 > 0x9F then return nil, i + 1 end
        return (b1 - 0xE0) * 4096 + (b2 - 0x80) * 64 + (b3 - 0x80), i + 3
    elseif b1 >= 0xF0 and b1 <= 0xF4 then
        if i + 3 > len then return nil, i + 1 end
        local b2, b3, b4 = s:byte(i + 1, i + 3)
        if not isCont(b2) or not isCont(b3) or not isCont(b4) then return nil, i + 1 end
        if b1 == 0xF0 and b2 < 0x90 then return nil, i + 1 end
        if b1 == 0xF4 and b2 > 0x8F then return nil, i + 1 end
        return (b1 - 0xF0) * 262144 + (b2 - 0x80) * 4096 + (b3 - 0x80) * 64 + (b4 - 0x80), i + 4
    end
    return nil, i + 1
end

-- Thai combining marks (U+0E31, U+0E34-U+0E3A, U+0E47-U+0E4E) count as 0 visible characters.
function M.isCombining(cp)
    return cp == 0x0E31
        or (cp >= 0x0E34 and cp <= 0x0E3A)
        or (cp >= 0x0E47 and cp <= 0x0E4E)
end

-- Control characters: U+0000-U+001F, U+007F, U+200B-U+200F, U+202A-U+202E.
function M.isControl(cp)
    return (cp >= 0x0000 and cp <= 0x001F)
        or cp == 0x007F
        or (cp >= 0x200B and cp <= 0x200F)
        or (cp >= 0x202A and cp <= 0x202E)
end

function M.len(s)
    if type(s) ~= 'string' then
        if s == nil then return 0 end
        s = tostring(s)
    end
    local byteLen = #s
    local i = 1
    local count = 0
    while i <= byteLen do
        local cp, nextIdx = decodeNext(s, i, byteLen)
        if cp ~= nil and not M.isCombining(cp) then
            count = count + 1
        end
        i = nextIdx
    end
    return count
end

function M.cut(s, n)
    if type(s) ~= 'string' then
        if s == nil then return '' end
        s = tostring(s)
    end
    if n ~= nil and n <= 0 then
        return ''
    end
    local byteLen = #s
    local i = 1
    local count = 0
    local hasBase = false
    local out = {}
    while i <= byteLen do
        local cp, nextIdx = decodeNext(s, i, byteLen)
        if cp ~= nil then
            if M.isCombining(cp) then
                if hasBase then
                    out[#out + 1] = s:sub(i, nextIdx - 1)
                end
            else
                if n ~= nil and count >= n then
                    break
                end
                count = count + 1
                hasBase = true
                out[#out + 1] = s:sub(i, nextIdx - 1)
            end
        end
        i = nextIdx
    end
    return table.concat(out)
end

function M.clean(s, maxLen)
    if type(s) ~= 'string' then
        if s == nil then return '' end
        s = tostring(s)
    end
    local byteLen = #s
    local i = 1
    local buf = {}
    while i <= byteLen do
        local cp, nextIdx = decodeNext(s, i, byteLen)
        if cp ~= nil and not M.isControl(cp) then
            buf[#buf + 1] = s:sub(i, nextIdx - 1)
        end
        i = nextIdx
    end
    local stripped = table.concat(buf)
    local trimmed = stripped:match('^%s*(.-)%s*$') or ''
    return M.cut(trimmed, maxLen)
end

AeternaCoreLogic.text = M
return M

-- LD CarWhitelist (client): stops players from getting into a locked seat. The server checks it again.

local STATE = 'ldcwAccess'
local BYPASS_VEHICLE = 'ldCarwhitelistBypass'

Rules.build()

--- What the server says this player may use: bypass, and a set of group indexes.
local function myAccess()
    local s = LocalPlayer.state[STATE]
    local set = {}
    if type(s) == 'table' and type(s.groups) == 'table' then
        for _, gi in pairs(s.groups) do set[tonumber(gi)] = true end
    end
    return type(s) == 'table' and s.bypass == true, set
end

--- Returns nil when the player may use this seat, otherwise the group that locks it.
local function lockedBy(vehicle, seat)
    if vehicle == 0 or not DoesEntityExist(vehicle) then return nil end
    if Entity(vehicle).state[BYPASS_VEHICLE] then return nil end
    -- right after joining the server hasn't sent the access yet: don't block (the server still checks)
    if LocalPlayer.state[STATE] == nil then return nil end
    local bypass, set = myAccess()
    if bypass then return nil end
    return Rules.lockedBy(Rules.groupsFor(GetEntityModel(vehicle), GetVehicleClass(vehicle)), set, seat)
end

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Notifications
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function started(res) return GetResourceState(res) == 'started' end

local function notify(message)
    local t = Config.Notify or 'auto'
    if t == 'none' then return end
    if t == 'auto' then
        t = started('ox_lib') and 'ox_lib' or started('es_extended') and 'esx'
            or (started('qb-core') or started('qbx_core')) and 'qb' or 'chat'
    end
    if t == 'ox_lib' then
        TriggerEvent('ox_lib:notify', { title = 'Vehicle', description = message, type = 'error' })
    elseif t == 'esx' then
        TriggerEvent('esx:showNotification', message, 'error')
    elseif t == 'qb' then
        TriggerEvent('QBCore:Notify', message, 'error')
    else
        TriggerEvent('chat:addMessage', { color = { 255, 90, 90 }, args = { 'Vehicle', message } })
    end
end

local lastNotify, lastReport = 0, 0
local function deny(vehicle, seat, group, key)
    local now = GetGameTimer()
    if now - lastNotify > 3000 then
        lastNotify = now
        notify(LDCWLText(key, Rules.label(group)))
    end
    if key == 'denied' and now - lastReport > 10000 and NetworkGetEntityIsNetworked(vehicle) then
        lastReport = now
        TriggerServerEvent('ld_carwhitelist:attempt', NetworkGetNetworkIdFromEntity(vehicle), seat)
    end
end

RegisterNetEvent('ld_carwhitelist:removed', function(label)
    lastNotify = GetGameTimer()
    notify(LDCWLText('removed', tostring(label)))
end)

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- The check
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function seatOf(ped, vehicle)
    for seat = -1, GetVehicleMaxNumberOfPassengers(vehicle) - 1 do
        if GetPedInVehicleSeat(vehicle, seat) == ped then return seat end
    end
end

CreateThread(function()
    while true do
        local wait = 300
        local ped = PlayerPedId()

        -- trying to get in: stop it before the door opens
        local target = GetVehiclePedIsTryingToEnter(ped)
        if target ~= 0 then
            wait = 50
            local seat = GetSeatPedIsTryingToEnter(ped)
            local group = lockedBy(target, seat)
            if group then
                ClearPedTasks(ped)
                deny(target, seat, group, 'denied')
            end
        end

        -- already inside (warped in by a script, access just taken away, ...): get out
        local vehicle = GetVehiclePedIsIn(ped, false)
        if vehicle ~= 0 then
            local seat = seatOf(ped, vehicle)
            local group = seat and lockedBy(vehicle, seat)
            if group then
                -- never out of a flying aircraft or a moving car: wait until it (nearly) stands still
                if GetEntitySpeed(vehicle) < 3.0 and not IsEntityInAir(vehicle) then
                    TaskLeaveVehicle(ped, vehicle, 0)
                end
                deny(vehicle, seat, group, 'removed')
                wait = 1000
            end
        end

        Wait(wait)
    end
end)

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Exports
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--- exports.ld_carwhitelist:canUse(vehicle, seat) -> true | false, groupLabel   (seat default -1 = driver)
exports('canUse', function(vehicle, seat)
    local group = lockedBy(vehicle, seat or -1)
    return group == nil, group and group.label

--[[
    LD CarWhitelist - configuration

    Lock vehicles to jobs or ACE permissions. Players without access can't get in: the game stops them
    while they try to enter, and the server checks again and removes anyone who got in anyway.

    Works with ESX, QBCore and Qbox (detected automatically). Without a framework, use ACE permissions.
]]

Config = {}

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- General
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Config.Locale = 'en'            -- en, nl, de, fr, es, pt, pl, tr
Config.VersionCheck = true      -- tell you in the server console when a new version is available
Config.Debug = false

-- Players with this ACE may use every vehicle (staff). `add_ace group.admin ldcw.bypass allow`
Config.BypassAce = 'ldcw.bypass'

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Groups
--   models     spawn names. Checked by the game AND by the server.
--   classes    vehicle classes, e.g. { 18 } = all emergency vehicles. Checked by the game only
--              (the server can't read classes), so list important models under `models` as well.
--   jobs       job name = minimum grade (0 = every grade)
--   ace        players with this ACE permission may always use the group (nil = none)
--   onDuty     true = jobs only count while on duty (QBCore/Qbox duty, ESX when your ESX has it)
--   seats      'driver' = only driving is locked, passengers may get in (e.g. someone under arrest)
--              'all'    = every seat is locked
--   A vehicle in several groups may be used by anyone with access to one of them.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Config.Groups = {
    {
        label = 'Police',
        models = { 'police', 'police2', 'police3', 'police4', 'policeb', 'policet', 'policeold1', 'policeold2',
            'sheriff', 'sheriff2', 'fbi', 'fbi2', 'pranger', 'riot', 'riot2', 'polmav', 'predator' },
        classes = {},
        jobs = { police = 0, sheriff = 0 },
        ace = 'ldcw.police',
        onDuty = false,
        seats = 'driver',
    },
    {
        label = 'EMS',
        models = { 'ambulance', 'lguard' },
        jobs = { ambulance = 0, ems = 0 },
        ace = 'ldcw.ems',
        seats = 'driver',
    },
    {
        label = 'Fire department',
        models = { 'firetruk' },
        jobs = { fire = 0, firefighter = 0, ambulance = 0 },
        ace = 'ldcw.fire',
        seats = 'driver',
    },
    -- {
    --     label = 'Mechanic',
    --     models = { 'towtruck', 'towtruck2', 'flatbed' },
    --     jobs = { mechanic = 0 },
    -- },
}

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Server check
--   Every few seconds the server looks at who is driving what, and removes players without access.
--   This also catches players who were put into a vehicle by a script or a cheat.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Config.ServerCheck = true
Config.ServerCheckInterval = 1500   -- milliseconds

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Notifications
--   'auto' = ox_lib, then ESX, then QBCore/Qbox, then chat. Or 'ox_lib' | 'esx' | 'qb' | 'chat' | 'none'
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Config.Notify = 'auto'

-- Pure timezone and civil-time arithmetic for aeterna_core. No natives.

AeternaCoreLogic = AeternaCoreLogic or {}

local M = {}

function M.parseOffset(tzStr)
    if type(tzStr) ~= 'string' then
        return nil
    end
    local sign, h, m = tzStr:match('^([%+%-])(%d%d):(%d%d)$')
    if not sign then
        return nil
    end
    local hh = tonumber(h)
    local mm = tonumber(m)
    if not hh or not mm or hh < 0 or hh > 23 or mm < 0 or mm > 59 then
        return nil
    end
    local total = hh * 3600 + mm * 60
    if sign == '-' then
        return -total
    end
    return total
end

function M.parts(ts, tzStr)
    local unix = math.floor(tonumber(ts) or 0)
    local offset = M.parseOffset(tzStr or '+00:00') or 0
    local localTs = unix + offset

    local days = math.floor(localTs / 86400)
    local rem = localTs - days * 86400
    local hour = math.floor(rem / 3600)
    rem = rem - hour * 3600
    local min = math.floor(rem / 60)
    local sec = math.floor(rem - min * 60)

    -- 1970-01-01 (days = 0) was Thursday (wday = 5); 1 = Sunday ... 7 = Saturday
    local wday = ((days + 4) % 7) + 1

    local z = days + 719468
    local era = math.floor((z >= 0 and z or (z - 146096)) / 146097)
    local doe = z - era * 146097
    local yoe = math.floor((doe - math.floor(doe / 1460) + math.floor(doe / 36524) - math.floor(doe / 146096)) / 365)
    local y = yoe + era * 400
    local doy = doe - (365 * yoe + math.floor(yoe / 4) - math.floor(yoe / 100))
    local mp = math.floor((5 * doy + 2) / 153)
    local d = doy - math.floor((153 * mp + 2) / 5) + 1
    local m = mp + (mp < 10 and 3 or -9)
    if m <= 2 then
        y = y + 1
    end

    return {
        year = y,
        month = m,
        day = d,
        hour = hour,
        min = min,
        sec = sec,
        wday = wday,
    }
end

function M.format(ts, pattern, tzStr, translateFn)
    local p = M.parts(ts, tzStr)
    local pat = tostring(pattern or 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss')
    local tFn = translateFn or function(k) return k end

    local tokens = {
        YYYY = string.format('%04d', p.year),
        MMMM = tostring(tFn('core.month.' .. tostring(p.month))),
        dddd = tostring(tFn('core.wday.' .. tostring(p.wday))),
        WWWW = tostring(tFn('core.wday.' .. tostring(p.wday))),
        MM   = string.format('%02d', p.month),
        DD   = string.format('%02d', p.day),
        HH   = string.format('%02d', p.hour),
        mm   = string.format('%02d', p.min),
        ss   = string.format('%02d', p.sec),
    }

    local out = {}
    local i = 1
    local len = #pat
    while i <= len do
        local sub4 = (i + 3 <= len) and pat:sub(i, i + 3) or nil
        local sub2 = (i + 1 <= len) and pat:sub(i, i + 1) or nil
        if sub4 and tokens[sub4] then
            out[#out + 1] = tokens[sub4]
            i = i + 4
        elseif sub2 and tokens[sub2] then
            out[#out + 1] = tokens[sub2]
            i = i + 2
        else
            out[#out + 1] = pat:sub(i, i)
            i = i + 1
        end
    end
    return table.concat(out)
end

AeternaCoreLogic.time = M
return M

-- Pure payload schema validator for aeterna_core. No natives.

AeternaCoreLogic = AeternaCoreLogic or {}

local M = {}

local function getTextHelper()
    if AeternaCoreLogic and AeternaCoreLogic.text then
        return AeternaCoreLogic.text
    end
    local ok, mod = pcall(require, 'packages.core.shared.logic.text')
    if ok and type(mod) == 'table' then
        return mod
    end
    return {
        len = function(s) return type(s) == 'string' and #s or 0 end,
        cut = function(s, n)
            s = tostring(s or '')
            if n and #s > n then return s:sub(1, n) end
            return s
        end,
        clean = function(s, maxLen)
            s = tostring(s or ''):gsub('[%c]', ''):match('^%s*(.-)%s*$') or ''
            if maxLen and #s > maxLen then return s:sub(1, maxLen) end
            return s
        end,
    }
end

local function inEnum(val, list)
    for i = 1, #list do
        if list[i] == val then
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

local function isArrayTable(t)
    local n = #t
    local count = 0
    for k in pairs(t) do
        if type(k) ~= 'number' or k < 1 or k > n or math.floor(k) ~= k then
            return false, 0
        end
        count = count + 1
    end
    return count == n, n
end

local function validateNode(value, schema, path, textHelper)
    local p = (path and path ~= '') and path or 'value'
    if type(schema) ~= 'table' then
        return false, p .. ': schema', nil
    end

    if value == nil then
        if schema.optional == true then
            return true, nil, schema.default
        end
        return false, p .. ': type', nil
    end

    local kind = schema.type
    if kind == 'string' then
        if type(value) ~= 'string' then
            return false, p .. ': type', nil
        end
        local cleaned = textHelper.clean(value, schema.maxLen)
        if schema.minLen ~= nil and textHelper.len(cleaned) < schema.minLen then
            return false, p .. ': minLen ' .. tostring(schema.minLen), nil
        end
        if type(schema.enum) == 'table' and not inEnum(cleaned, schema.enum) then
            return false, p .. ': enum', nil
        end
        if type(schema.pattern) == 'string' and not cleaned:find(schema.pattern) then
            return false, p .. ': pattern', nil
        end
        return true, nil, cleaned
    elseif kind == 'number' then
        if type(value) ~= 'number' or value ~= value or value == math.huge or value == -math.huge then
            return false, p .. ': type', nil
        end
        if schema.integer == true and math.floor(value) ~= value then
            return false, p .. ': integer', nil
        end
        if schema.min ~= nil and value < schema.min then
            return false, p .. ': min ' .. tostring(schema.min), nil
        end
        if schema.max ~= nil and value > schema.max then
            return false, p .. ': max ' .. tostring(schema.max), nil
        end
        if type(schema.enum) == 'table' and not inEnum(value, schema.enum) then
            return false, p .. ': enum', nil
        end
        return true, nil, value
    elseif kind == 'boolean' then
        if type(value) ~= 'boolean' then
            return false, p .. ': type', nil
        end
        return true, nil, value
    elseif kind == 'table' then
        if type(value) ~= 'table' then
            return false, p .. ': type', nil
        end
        local fields = schema.fields
        local allowExtra = (schema.extra == true)

        if schema.maxKeys ~= nil then
            local keyCount = 0
            for _ in pairs(value) do
                keyCount = keyCount + 1
            end
            if keyCount > schema.maxKeys then
                return false, p .. ': maxKeys ' .. tostring(schema.maxKeys), nil
            end
        end

        if type(fields) == 'table' and not allowExtra then
            local extras = {}
            for k in pairs(value) do
                if fields[k] == nil then
                    extras[#extras + 1] = tostring(k)
                end
            end
            if #extras > 0 then
                table.sort(extras)
                local extraKey = extras[1]
                local extraPath = (path and path ~= '') and (path .. '.' .. extraKey) or extraKey
                return false, extraPath .. ': not allowed', nil
            end
        end

        local clean = {}
        if type(fields) == 'table' then
            local keys = {}
            for k in pairs(fields) do
                keys[#keys + 1] = k
            end
            table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)

            for i = 1, #keys do
                local k = keys[i]
                local fSchema = fields[k]
                local childPath = (path and path ~= '') and (path .. '.' .. tostring(k)) or tostring(k)
                local ok, err, cVal = validateNode(value[k], fSchema, childPath, textHelper)
                if not ok then
                    return false, err, nil
                end
                clean[k] = cVal
            end
        end

        if allowExtra or type(fields) ~= 'table' then
            for k, v in pairs(value) do
                if type(fields) ~= 'table' or fields[k] == nil then
                    if type(v) == 'string' then
                        clean[k] = textHelper.clean(v)
                    else
                        clean[k] = v
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        return true, nil, clean
    elseif kind == 'array' then
        if type(value) ~= 'table' then
            return false, p .. ': type', nil
        end
        local isArr, n = isArrayTable(value)
        if not isArr then
            return false, p .. ': type', nil
        end
        if schema.minItems ~= nil and n < schema.minItems then
            return false, p .. ': minItems ' .. tostring(schema.minItems), nil
        end
        if schema.maxItems ~= nil and n > schema.maxItems then
            return false, p .. ': maxItems ' .. tostring(schema.maxItems), nil
        end
        local clean = {}
        for i = 1, n do
            if type(schema.items) == 'table' then
                local itemPath = p .. '[' .. tostring(i) .. ']'
                local ok, err, cItem = validateNode(value[i], schema.items, itemPath, textHelper)
                if not ok then
                    return false, err, nil
                end
                clean[i] = cItem
            elseif type(value[i]) == 'string' then
                clean[i] = textHelper.clean(value[i])
            else
                clean[i] = value[i]
            end
        end
        return true, nil, clean
    end

    return false, p .. ': type', nil
end

function M.validate(value, schema)
    return validateNode(value, schema, '', getTextHelper())
end

setmetatable(M, {
    __call = function(_, value, schema)
        return M.validate(value, schema)
    end,
})

AeternaCoreLogic.validate = M
return M
