-- natives.lua -- stub FiveM globals so plain resource scripts can run under busted.
--
-- FiveM resource scripts are not modules: they call CreateThread / AddEventHandler / exports / GetConvar
-- at the top level and talk to the world through globals. This helper installs those globals into _G,
-- records everything the script does (events, exports, convar writes, spied natives) and gives the spec a
-- controllable clock that drives threads, Wait() and SetTimeout().
--
--   local natives = require('helpers.natives')
--   before_each(function() natives.reset({ resource = 'my_resource', side = 'server' }) end)
--
-- Every reset() starts from a clean slate: fresh registries, clock at 0, and every global this helper
-- (or resource.lua) installed is removed first. Compatible with Lua 5.1 - 5.5.

local M = {}

local unpack = table.unpack or unpack -- luacheck: ignore 143

local installed = {}  -- global name -> true for every global we put into _G
local state           -- current registries, rebuilt on every reset()

local function set_global(name, value)
    installed[name] = true
    rawset(_G, name, value)
end

--- Remember that `name` is a global owned by the harness, so reset() removes it.
function M.track_global(name)
    installed[name] = true
end

local function pack(...)
    return { n = select('#', ...), ... }
end

local function record(list, entry)
    list[#list + 1] = entry
    return entry
end

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- json: dkjson when available (it is a dependency of busted itself), else a small encoder.
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function simple_encode(v, seen)
    local t = type(v)
    if t == 'nil' then return 'null' end
    if t == 'boolean' then return tostring(v) end
    if t == 'number' then
        if v ~= v or v == math.huge or v == -math.huge then return 'null' end
        if v == math.floor(v) and math.abs(v) < 2^53 then return string.format('%d', v) end
        return string.format('%.14g', v)
    end
    if t == 'string' then
        local escaped = v:gsub('[%c"\\]', function(c)
            local map = { ['"'] = '\\"', ['\\'] = '\\\\', ['\n'] = '\\n', ['\r'] = '\\r', ['\t'] = '\\t' }
            return map[c] or string.format('\\u%04x', c:byte())
        end)
        return '"' .. escaped .. '"'
    end
    if t == 'table' then
        seen = seen or {}
        if seen[v] then error('json.encode: cyclic table', 0) end
        seen[v] = true
        local n = #v
        local is_array = true
        for k in pairs(v) do
            if type(k) ~= 'number' or k < 1 or k > n or k ~= math.floor(k) then is_array = false break end
        end
        local parts = {}
        if is_array then
            for i = 1, n do parts[i] = simple_encode(v[i], seen) end
            seen[v] = nil
            return '[' .. table.concat(parts, ',') .. ']'
        end
        local keys = {}
        for k in pairs(v) do keys[#keys + 1] = tostring(k) end
        table.sort(keys)
        for _, k in ipairs(keys) do
            local val = v[k]
            if val == nil then val = v[tonumber(k)] end
            parts[#parts + 1] = simple_encode(k, seen) .. ':' .. simple_encode(val, seen)
        end
        seen[v] = nil
        return '{' .. table.concat(parts, ',') .. '}'
    end
    error('json.encode: cannot encode ' .. t, 0)
end

local function make_json()
    local ok, dk = pcall(require, 'dkjson')
    if ok and type(dk) == 'table' then
        return {
            encode = function(v) return dk.encode(v) end,
            decode = function(s)
                local v = dk.decode(s)
                return v
            end,
            backend = 'dkjson',
        }
    end
    return {
        encode = function(v) return simple_encode(v) end,
        decode = function() error('json.decode needs dkjson (luarocks install dkjson)', 2) end,
        backend = 'simple',
    }
end

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- vector3: enough for coords math. `#(a - b)` works on Lua 5.2+ only (5.1 ignores __len on tables);
-- use natives.length(v) in specs that must also run on 5.1.
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local vec_mt = {}
vec_mt.__index = vec_mt

local function vector3(x, y, z)
    if type(x) == 'table' then x, y, z = x.x, x.y, x.z end
    return setmetatable({ x = x or 0.0, y = y or 0.0, z = z or 0.0 }, vec_mt)
end

local function as_vec(v)
    if type(v) == 'number' then return { x = v, y = v, z = v } end
    return v
end

vec_mt.__add = function(a, b) a, b = as_vec(a), as_vec(b) return vector3(a.x + b.x, a.y + b.y, a.z + b.z) end
vec_mt.__sub = function(a, b) a, b = as_vec(a), as_vec(b) return vector3(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y, a.z - b.z) end
vec_mt.__mul = function(a, b) a, b = as_vec(a), as_vec(b) return vector3(a.x * b.x, a.y * b.y, a.z * b.z) end
vec_mt.__unm = function(a) return vector3(-a.x, -a.y, -a.z) end
vec_mt.__eq = function(a, b) return a.x == b.x and a.y == b.y and a.z == b.z end
vec_mt.__len = function(a) return math.sqrt(a.x * a.x + a.y * a.y + a.z * a.z) end
vec_mt.__tostring = function(a) return ('vector3(%g, %g, %g)'):format(a.x, a.y, a.z) end

--- Length of a vector3 (portable replacement for `#v`).
function M.length(v) return vec_mt.__len(v) end

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Scheduler: threads are coroutines woken by the fake clock. Nothing runs until the spec calls
-- natives.advance(ms) -- like FiveM, CreateThread schedules for the next tick, it does not run inline.
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local MAX_STEPS = 100000

local function current_thread()
    local co, is_main = coroutine.running()
    if co == nil or is_main then return nil end
    for _, th in ipairs(state.threads) do
        if th.co == co then return th end
    end
    return nil
end

local function schedule_thread(fn, label)
    local th = { co = coroutine.create(fn), wake = state.clock.now, label = label or 'thread' }
    record(state.threads, th)
    return th
end

local function wait(ms)
    local th = current_thread()
    if not th then
        -- Top-level Wait() in a script body: nothing to suspend. Treat it as a no-op.
        return
    end
    ms = tonumber(ms) or 0
    if ms < 1 then ms = 1 end -- Wait(0) = "next frame"; 1 ms keeps advance() finite
    coroutine.yield(ms)
end

local function next_due(target)
    local best_kind, best, best_idx
    for i, th in ipairs(state.threads) do
        if not th.dead and th.wake <= target and (not best or th.wake < best.wake) then
            best_kind, best, best_idx = 'thread', th, i
        end
    end
    for i, tm in ipairs(state.timers) do
        if not tm.cleared and tm.wake <= target and (not best or tm.wake < best.wake) then
            best_kind, best, best_idx = 'timer', tm, i
        end
    end
    return best_kind, best, best_idx
end

local function resume(th)
    local ok, ms = coroutine.resume(th.co)
    if not ok then
        th.dead = true
        error(('%s raised: %s'):format(th.label, tostring(ms)), 0)
    end
    if coroutine.status(th.co) == 'dead' then
        th.dead = true
    else
        th.wake = state.clock.now + (ms or 1)
    end
end

--- Advance the fake clock by `ms` (default 0), running every thread / timer that falls due, in time order.
--- Returns the number of thread resumes + timer callbacks executed.
function M.advance(ms)
    local target = state.clock.now + (tonumber(ms) or 0)
    local steps = 0
    while true do
        local kind, item, idx = next_due(target)
        if not kind then break end
        steps = steps + 1
        if steps > MAX_STEPS then
            error('natives.advance: more than ' .. MAX_STEPS .. ' steps -- a thread loops without Wait()?', 2)
        end
        if item.wake > state.clock.now then state.clock.now = item.wake end
        if kind == 'thread' then
            resume(item)
        else
            table.remove(state.timers, idx)
            item.fn()
        end
    end
    state.clock.now = target
    -- drop finished threads so the list does not grow forever
    for i = #state.threads, 1, -1 do
        if state.threads[i].dead then table.remove(state.threads, i) end
    end
    return steps
end

--- Number of live (not finished) threads.
function M.thread_count()
    local n = 0
    for _, th in ipairs(state.threads) do if not th.dead then n = n + 1 end end
    return n
end

--- Current fake time in ms (what GetGameTimer() returns).
function M.now() return state.clock.now end

--- Set the fake clock directly (does not run anything).
function M.set_time(ms) state.clock.now = ms end

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Events
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function dispatch(name, src, args)
    local list = state.handlers[name]
    if not list then return 0 end
    local copy = {}
    for i, h in ipairs(list) do copy[i] = h end
    local prev_source = rawget(_G, 'source')
    local n = 0
    for _, h in ipairs(copy) do
        if not h.removed then
            n = n + 1
            rawset(_G, 'source', src)
            local ok, err = pcall(h.fn, unpack(args, 1, args.n))
            rawset(_G, 'source', prev_source)
            if not ok then error(err, 0) end
        end
    end
    return n
end

local function add_handler(name, fn)
    state.handlers[name] = state.handlers[name] or {}
    local h = { name = name, fn = fn }
    record(state.handlers[name], h)
    return h
end

--- Every captured call of one kind: 'local' (TriggerEvent), 'client' (TriggerClientEvent),
--- 'server' (TriggerServerEvent). Optional `name` filters by event name.
--- Each entry: { name = ..., target = <client id, client kind only>, args = { n = ..., ... } }
function M.emitted(kind, name)
    local list = state.emitted[kind]
    if not list then error('natives.emitted: unknown kind ' .. tostring(kind), 2) end
    if not name then return list end
    local out = {}
    for _, e in ipairs(list) do if e.name == name then out[#out + 1] = e end end
    return out
end

--- Last captured call of `kind` (optionally filtered by `name`), or nil.
function M.last_emitted(kind, name)
    local list = M.emitted(kind, name)
    return list[#list]
end

--- Fire a local event (as another resource or the engine would). Returns handlers run.
function M.fire(name, ...)
    return dispatch(name, rawget(_G, 'source'), pack(...))
end

--- Simulate a client sending a net event to the server. Only handlers of events registered with
--- RegisterNetEvent are reachable (as in FiveM). `source` is set to `src` while they run.
--- Returns handlers run (0 when the event is not net-registered).
function M.fire_net(name, src, ...)
    if not state.net_events[name] then return 0 end
    return dispatch(name, src, pack(...))
end

--- Number of handlers registered for an event.
function M.handler_count(name)
    local n = 0
    for _, h in ipairs(state.handlers[name] or {}) do if not h.removed then n = n + 1 end end
    return n
end

--- true when RegisterNetEvent was called for `name`.
function M.is_net_event(name) return state.net_events[name] == true end

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Exports: exports('name', fn) registers for the current resource; exports.res:name(...) calls it.
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function export_proxy(resource)
    return setmetatable({}, {
        __index = function(_, fname)
            return function(_self, ...)
                local bucket = state.exports[resource]
                local fn = bucket and bucket[fname]
                if not fn then
                    error(('No such export %s in resource %s'):format(tostring(fname), tostring(resource)), 2)
                end
                return fn(...)
            end
        end,
    })
end

local function make_exports()
    return setmetatable({}, {
        __call = function(_, fname, fn)
            local res = state.resource
            state.exports[res] = state.exports[res] or {}
            state.exports[res][fname] = fn
        end,
        __index = function(_, resource) return export_proxy(resource) end,
    })
end

--- Stub an export of another resource: natives.stub_export('ox_inventory', 'GetItem', fn).
--- `fn` receives the arguments WITHOUT the colon-call self.
function M.stub_export(resource, fname, fn)
    state.exports[resource] = state.exports[resource] or {}
    state.exports[resource][fname] = fn
end

--- Exports registered by `resource` (defaults to the current resource).
function M.exports_of(resource)
    return state.exports[resource or state.resource] or {}
end

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Spies: record calls to any native the harness does not model.
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

--- Install global `name` that records every call; `impl` (optional) provides the return value.
--- Returns the call list: each entry is a packed argument table ({ n = ..., ... }).
function M.spy(name, impl)
    local calls = {}
    state.spies[name] = calls
    set_global(name, function(...)
        record(calls, pack(...))
        if impl then return impl(...) end
    end)
    return calls
end

--- Calls recorded by M.spy(name) (empty table when never spied).
function M.calls(name) return state.spies[name] or {} end

--- Install (or replace) any global the script needs, and have reset() remove it later.
function M.stub(name, value)
    set_global(name, value)
    return value
end

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Players / convars helpers
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

--- Add a connected player (server side). id is a number; name is what GetPlayerName returns.
function M.add_player(id, name)
    state.players[tonumber(id)] = { name = name or ('player' .. tostring(id)) }
end

function M.remove_player(id) state.players[tonumber(id)] = nil end

--- Set a convar as the server config would (`set name value`).
function M.set_convar(name, value) state.convars[name] = tostring(value) end

--- Convar writes made by the script via SetConvar*: { { name, value, kind } ... }
function M.convar_writes() return state.convar_writes end

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- KVP (key-value storage) helpers
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

--- Get a stored KVP string value.
function M.get_kvp(key) return state.kvp[tostring(key)] end

--- Set a KVP string value.
function M.set_kvp(key, val)
    if val == nil then state.kvp[tostring(key)] = nil
    else state.kvp[tostring(key)] = tostring(val) end
end

--- Shallow copy of the full KVP store table.
function M.kvp_table()
    local copy = {}
    for k, v in pairs(state.kvp) do copy[k] = v end
    return copy
end

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Statebags / routing / entity helpers
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

--- Read raw statebag data table for handle `h`.
function M.entity_state(h)
    local key = tonumber(h) or h
    return state.entity_state[key] or {}
end

--- Set a statebag key on handle `h`.
function M.set_entity_state(h, key, val)
    local k = tonumber(h) or h
    state.entity_state[k] = state.entity_state[k] or {}
    state.entity_state[k][key] = val
end

--- Get routing bucket for player `src` (default 0).
function M.player_bucket(src) return state.player_buckets[tonumber(src)] or 0 end

--- Set routing bucket for player `src`.
function M.set_player_bucket(src, b) state.player_buckets[tonumber(src)] = tonumber(b) or 0 end

--- Get routing bucket for entity `ent` (default 0).
function M.entity_bucket(ent) return state.entity_buckets[tonumber(ent)] or 0 end

--- Set routing bucket for entity `ent`.
function M.set_entity_bucket(ent, b) state.entity_buckets[tonumber(ent)] = tonumber(b) or 0 end

--- Register a mock vehicle for GetAllVehicles() / GetVehicle* queries.
function M.add_vehicle(h, opts)
    opts = opts or {}
    local key = tonumber(h) or h
    state.vehicles[key] = {
        plate = opts.plate or '',
        engine = opts.engine or 1000.0,
        body = opts.body or 1000.0,
        seats = opts.seats or {},
    }
    state.entities[key] = {
        exist = true,
        coords = opts.coords or vector3(0.0, 0.0, 0.0),
        health = opts.health or 1000,
        model = opts.model or 0,
    }
end

--- Register a mock ped for GetAllPeds() queries.
function M.add_ped(h, opts)
    opts = opts or {}
    local key = tonumber(h) or h
    state.peds[key] = true
    state.entities[key] = {
        exist = true,
        coords = opts.coords or vector3(0.0, 0.0, 0.0),
        health = opts.health or 200,
        model = opts.model or 0,
    }
end

--- Set entity coords vector3.
function M.set_entity_coords(h, coords)
    local key = tonumber(h) or h
    state.entities[key] = state.entities[key] or { exist = true }
    state.entities[key].coords = coords
end

--- Set entity health.
function M.set_entity_health(h, health)
    local key = tonumber(h) or h
    state.entities[key] = state.entities[key] or { exist = true }
    state.entities[key].health = health
end

--- The current registries (advanced use / debugging).
function M.state() return state end

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- reset / install
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

--- reset{ resource = 'name', side = 'server'|'client', convars = {...}, players = { [1] = 'Alice' } }
--- Removes every global installed earlier, rebuilds all registries and installs fresh stubs.
function M.reset(opts)
    opts = opts or {}
    for name in pairs(installed) do rawset(_G, name, nil) end
    installed = {}

    state = {
        resource = opts.resource or 'spec_resource',
        side = opts.side or 'server',
        clock = { now = opts.now or 0 },
        threads = {},
        timers = {},
        handlers = {},
        net_events = {},
        emitted = { ['local'] = {}, client = {}, server = {} },
        exports = {},
        spies = {},
        players = {},
        convars = {},
        convar_writes = {},
        kvp = {},
        entity_state = {},
        player_buckets = {},
        entity_buckets = {},
        entities = {},
        vehicles = {},
        peds = {},
    }
    for k, v in pairs(opts.convars or {}) do state.convars[k] = tostring(v) end
    for id, name in pairs(opts.players or {}) do M.add_player(id, name) end
    for k, v in pairs(opts.kvp or {}) do state.kvp[tostring(k)] = tostring(v) end
    for h, s in pairs(opts.entity_state or {}) do
        local key = tonumber(h) or h
        state.entity_state[key] = {}
        for k, v in pairs(s) do state.entity_state[key][k] = v end
    end
    for res, tbl in pairs(opts.exports or {}) do
        for fname, fn in pairs(tbl) do M.stub_export(res, fname, fn) end
    end
    for h, vopts in pairs(opts.vehicles or {}) do M.add_vehicle(h, vopts) end
    for h, popts in pairs(opts.peds or {}) do M.add_ped(h, popts) end

    -- threads / timers
    local function create_thread(fn) schedule_thread(fn) end
    local timer_seq = 0
    local function set_timeout(ms, fn)
        timer_seq = timer_seq + 1
        record(state.timers, { id = timer_seq, wake = state.clock.now + (tonumber(ms) or 0), fn = fn })
        return timer_seq
    end
    local function clear_timeout(id)
        for _, tm in ipairs(state.timers) do if tm.id == id then tm.cleared = true end end
    end

    set_global('CreateThread', create_thread)
    set_global('Wait', wait)
    set_global('SetTimeout', set_timeout)
    set_global('ClearTimeout', clear_timeout)
    set_global('Citizen', {
        CreateThread = create_thread,
        CreateThreadNow = function(fn) resume(schedule_thread(fn)) end,
        Wait = wait,
        SetTimeout = set_timeout,
        ClearTimeout = clear_timeout,
        Trace = function(s) io.write(tostring(s)) end,
    })
    set_global('GetGameTimer', function() return state.clock.now end)

    -- events
    set_global('AddEventHandler', function(name, fn) return add_handler(name, fn) end)
    set_global('RemoveEventHandler', function(h) if type(h) == 'table' then h.removed = true end end)
    set_global('RegisterNetEvent', function(name, fn)
        state.net_events[name] = true
        if fn then return add_handler(name, fn) end
    end)
    set_global('RegisterServerEvent', rawget(_G, 'RegisterNetEvent'))
    set_global('CancelEvent', function() end)
    set_global('WasEventCanceled', function() return false end)
    set_global('TriggerEvent', function(name, ...)
        local args = pack(...)
        record(state.emitted['local'], { name = name, args = args })
        dispatch(name, rawget(_G, 'source'), args)
    end)
    set_global('TriggerClientEvent', function(name, target, ...)
        record(state.emitted.client, { name = name, target = target, args = pack(...) })
    end)
    set_global('TriggerLatentClientEvent', function(name, target, _bps, ...)
        record(state.emitted.client, { name = name, target = target, args = pack(...), latent = true })
    end)
    set_global('TriggerServerEvent', function(name, ...)
        record(state.emitted.server, { name = name, args = pack(...) })
    end)
    set_global('TriggerLatentServerEvent', function(name, _bps, ...)
        record(state.emitted.server, { name = name, args = pack(...), latent = true })
    end)

    -- exports
    set_global('exports', make_exports())

    -- convars
    local function read_convar(name, default)
        local v = state.convars[name]
        if v == nil then return default end
        return v
    end
    set_global('GetConvar', function(name, default) return read_convar(name, default) end)
    set_global('GetConvarInt', function(name, default)
        local v = tonumber(state.convars[name])
        if v == nil then return default end
        return math.floor(v)
    end)
    set_global('GetConvarFloat', function(name, default)
        local v = tonumber(state.convars[name])
        if v == nil then return default end
        return v
    end)
    set_global('GetConvarBool', function(name, default)
        local v = state.convars[name]
        if v == nil then return default end
        return v == 'true' or v == '1'
    end)
    local function writer(kind)
        return function(name, value)
            state.convars[name] = tostring(value)
            record(state.convar_writes, { name = name, value = tostring(value), kind = kind })
        end
    end
    set_global('SetConvar', writer('SetConvar'))
    set_global('SetConvarReplicated', writer('SetConvarReplicated'))
    set_global('SetConvarServerInfo', writer('SetConvarServerInfo'))

    -- players
    set_global('GetPlayerName', function(id)
        local p = state.players[tonumber(id)]
        return p and p.name or nil
    end)
    set_global('GetPlayers', function()
        local ids = {}
        for id in pairs(state.players) do ids[#ids + 1] = id end
        table.sort(ids)
        for i, id in ipairs(ids) do ids[i] = tostring(id) end -- FiveM returns strings
        return ids
    end)
    set_global('GetNumPlayerIndices', function()
        local n = 0
        for _ in pairs(state.players) do n = n + 1 end
        return n
    end)
    set_global('DropPlayer', function(id, reason)
        state.players[tonumber(id)] = nil
        record(state.emitted['local'], { name = 'DropPlayer', target = id, args = pack(reason) })
    end)
    set_global('source', nil)

    -- resource / runtime
    set_global('GetCurrentResourceName', function() return state.resource end)
    set_global('GetInvokingResource', function() return opts.invoker end)
    set_global('IsDuplicityVersion', function() return state.side == 'server' end)
    set_global('json', opts.json or make_json())
    set_global('vector3', vector3)
    set_global('vec3', vector3)
    set_global('PlayerPedId', function() return 1 end)
    set_global('PlayerId', function() return 0 end)
    set_global('GetHashKey', function(s) return tostring(s) end) -- not joaat on purpose: pin names, not hashes

    -- KVP (key-value storage)
    set_global('GetResourceKvpString', function(key) return state.kvp[tostring(key)] end)
    set_global('GetResourceKvpInt', function(key)
        local v = tonumber(state.kvp[tostring(key)])
        return v and math.floor(v) or nil
    end)
    set_global('GetResourceKvpFloat', function(key)
        local v = tonumber(state.kvp[tostring(key)])
        return v
    end)
    set_global('SetResourceKvp', function(key, val) state.kvp[tostring(key)] = tostring(val) end)
    set_global('SetResourceKvpInt', function(key, val) state.kvp[tostring(key)] = tostring(math.floor(tonumber(val) or 0)) end)
    set_global('SetResourceKvpFloat', function(key, val) state.kvp[tostring(key)] = tostring(tonumber(val) or 0.0) end)
    set_global('DeleteResourceKvp', function(key) state.kvp[tostring(key)] = nil end)

    -- Statebags: Entity(h).state proxy with persistent fields and :set()
    local function state_bag_for(h)
        local key = tonumber(h) or h
        state.entity_state[key] = state.entity_state[key] or {}
        return state.entity_state[key]
    end
    set_global('Entity', function(h)
        local data = state_bag_for(h)
        local proxy = setmetatable({}, {
            __index = function(_, k)
                if k == 'set' then
                    return function(_self, key, val, _replicated)
                        data[key] = val
                    end
                end
                return data[k]
            end,
            __newindex = function(_, k, v)
                data[k] = v
            end,
        })
        return { state = proxy }
    end)

    -- Routing buckets
    set_global('GetPlayerRoutingBucket', function(src) return state.player_buckets[tonumber(src)] or 0 end)
    set_global('SetPlayerRoutingBucket', function(src, b) state.player_buckets[tonumber(src)] = tonumber(b) or 0 end)
    set_global('GetEntityRoutingBucket', function(ent) return state.entity_buckets[tonumber(ent)] or 0 end)
    set_global('SetEntityRoutingBucket', function(ent, b) state.entity_buckets[tonumber(ent)] = tonumber(b) or 0 end)

    -- World / Entity inspection
    set_global('DoesEntityExist', function(h)
        if not h or h == 0 then return false end
        local key = tonumber(h) or h
        if state.entities[key] and state.entities[key].exist ~= nil then return state.entities[key].exist end
        if state.entity_state[key] or state.players[key] or state.vehicles[key] or state.peds[key] then
            return true
        end
        return false
    end)
    set_global('GetEntityCoords', function(h)
        local key = tonumber(h) or h
        local e = state.entities[key]
        return (e and e.coords) or vector3(0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
    end)
    set_global('GetEntityHealth', function(h)
        local key = tonumber(h) or h
        local e = state.entities[key]
        return (e and e.health) or 200
    end)
    set_global('GetEntityModel', function(h)
        local key = tonumber(h) or h
        local e = state.entities[key]
        return (e and e.model) or 0
    end)
    set_global('GetAllVehicles', function()
        local list = {}
        for h in pairs(state.vehicles) do list[#list + 1] = h end
        table.sort(list, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
        return list
    end)
    set_global('GetAllPeds', function()
        local list = {}
        for h in pairs(state.peds) do list[#list + 1] = h end
        table.sort(list, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
        return list
    end)
    set_global('GetVehicleNumberPlateText', function(veh)
        local v = state.vehicles[tonumber(veh) or veh]
        return (v and v.plate) or ''
    end)
    set_global('GetVehicleEngineHealth', function(veh)
        local v = state.vehicles[tonumber(veh) or veh]
        return (v and v.engine) or 1000.0
    end)
    set_global('GetVehicleBodyHealth', function(veh)
        local v = state.vehicles[tonumber(veh) or veh]
        return (v and v.body) or 1000.0
    end)
    set_global('GetPedInVehicleSeat', function(veh, seat)
        local v = state.vehicles[tonumber(veh) or veh]
        return (v and v.seats and v.seats[tonumber(seat)]) or 0
    end)
    set_global('NetworkGetNetworkIdFromEntity', function(h) return h end)
    set_global('NetworkGetEntityFromNetworkId', function(netId) return netId end)

    -- Minimal ox_lib-style `lib` (opt in with reset{ lib = true }): only what is safe to fake.
    if opts.lib then
        set_global('lib', {
            print = { info = function() end, warn = function() end, error = function() end, debug = function() end },
            callback = setmetatable({ register = function() end }, { __call = function() end }),
            locale = function() end,
        })
    end

    return M
end

--- Which side the harness currently models ('server' or 'client').
function M.side() return state.side end

--- Switch the current resource name (what GetCurrentResourceName() and exports('x', fn) use).
function M.set_resource(name) state.resource = name end

M.reset()
return M

local loginAttempts = {}

AddEventHandler('playerDropped', function()
    inFlightActions[source] = nil
end)

local function AcquireActionLock(src, actionName)
    inFlightActions[src] = inFlightActions[src] or {}
    if inFlightActions[src][actionName] then
        return false
    end
    inFlightActions[src][actionName] = true
    return true
end

local function ReleaseActionLock(src, actionName)
    if inFlightActions[src] then
        inFlightActions[src][actionName] = nil
    end
end

local function IsPlayerNearStorage(src, player)
    if not player then return false, 'no_permission' end

    local metadata = player.PlayerData and player.PlayerData.metadata or {}
    if metadata.isdead or metadata.inlaststand then
        return false, 'dead_cannot_access'
    end

    local ped = GetPlayerPed(src)
    if not ped or ped == 0 then
        return false, 'too_far'
    end

    local playerCoords = GetEntityCoords(ped)
    local npcCoords = vector3(Config.NPC.coords.x, Config.NPC.coords.y, Config.NPC.coords.z)
    local maxDistance = (tonumber(Config.InteractionDistance) or 3.0) + 2.5

    if #(playerCoords - npcCoords) > maxDistance then
        return false, 'too_far'
    end

    return true
end

local function SanitizeImageUrl(rawImage)
    local value = tostring(rawImage or ''):gsub('^%s+', ''):gsub('%s+$', '')
    if value == '' or value == Config.DefaultImage then
        return Config.DefaultImage, true
    end

    if #value > 4096 then
        return nil, false
    end

    if value:find('[%s"\'<>]') then
        return nil, false
    end

    if string.lower(value:sub(1, 8)) ~= 'https://' then
        return nil, false
    end

    return value, true
end

local function DebugPrint(...)
    if Config.Debug then
        print('[zodi4c-storage]', ...)
    end
end

local function Notify(src, key, notifyType, ...)
    TriggerClientEvent('zodi4c-storage:client:sendNotify', src, L(key, ...), notifyType or 'info')
end

local function GetCharacterName(player)
    local charinfo = player.PlayerData.charinfo or {}
    local firstname = charinfo.firstname or ''
    local lastname = charinfo.lastname or ''
    local name = ('%s %s'):format(firstname, lastname):gsub('^%s+', ''):gsub('%s+$', '')
    if name == '' then
        return L('unknown_member')
    end
    return name
end

local function NormalizeName(name)
    local value = tostring(name or '')
    value = value:gsub('^%s+', ''):gsub('%s+$', '')
    return value:sub(1, 100)
end

-- Passwords are stored case-insensitively. This keeps passwords easy to type on
-- the in-game prompt and remains compatible with existing installations.
local function NormalizePassword(password)
    if not password then return nil end
    local value = tostring(password)
    if value == '' then return nil end
    return string.lower(value)
end

local function VerifyPassword(stored, provided)
    if not stored or stored == '' then return true end
    if not provided then return false end
    return string.lower(tostring(provided)) == stored
end

local function ValidatePassword(password)
    if not password or password == '' then return true end

    local minLength = tonumber(Config.Security.minPasswordLength) or 4
    local maxLength = tonumber(Config.Security.maxPasswordLength) or 50

    if #password < minLength then
        return false, 'password_too_short', minLength
    end
    if #password > maxLength then
        return false, 'password_too_long', maxLength
    end

    return true
end

local function GetLoginState(citizenid)
    local state = loginAttempts[citizenid]
    if state and state.lockedUntil and state.lockedUntil <= os.time() then
        loginAttempts[citizenid] = nil
        return nil
    end
    return state
end

local function RegisterFailedAttempt(citizenid)
    local maxAttempts = math.max(1, tonumber(Config.Security.maxLoginAttempts) or 3)
    local lockoutDuration = math.max(1, tonumber(Config.Security.lockoutDuration) or 300)
    local state = GetLoginState(citizenid) or { count = 0 }

    state.count = state.count + 1
    if state.count >= maxAttempts then
        state.lockedUntil = os.time() + lockoutDuration
    end

    loginAttempts[citizenid] = state
    return state
end

local function LogAction(storageId, citizenid, name, action, details)
    MySQL.insert(
        'INSERT INTO zodi4c_storage_logs (storage_id, citizenid, name, action, details) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)',
        { storageId, citizenid, name, action, details }
    )
end

-- Log item movement in and out of a storage stash.
exports.ox_inventory:registerHook('swapItems', function(payload)
    local src = payload.source
    if not src then return true end

    local player = QBCore.Functions.GetPlayer(src)
    if not player then return true end

    local fromInventory = tostring(payload.fromInventory or '')
    local toInventory = tostring(payload.toInventory or '')
    if fromInventory == toInventory then return true end

    local storageId, action

    if fromInventory:find(STASH_PREFIX, 1, true) then
        storageId = tonumber(fromInventory:match(STASH_PREFIX .. '(%d+)'))
        action = 'take'
    elseif toInventory:find(STASH_PREFIX, 1, true) then
        storageId = tonumber(toInventory:match(STASH_PREFIX .. '(%d+)'))
        action = 'put'
    end

    if storageId and payload.fromSlot then
        local count = payload.count or payload.fromSlot.count or 0
        local label = payload.fromSlot.label or payload.fromSlot.name or '?'
        local details = ('%sx %s'):format(count, label)

        LogAction(storageId, player.PlayerData.citizenid, GetCharacterName(player), action, details)
    end

    return true
end, {
    inventoryFilter = {
        '^' .. STASH_PREFIX .. '%d+'
    }
})

local function OpenStash(src, storageId, storage)
    local player = QBCore.Functions.GetPlayer(src)
    if not player then return end

    local citizenid = player.PlayerData.citizenid
    local charName = GetCharacterName(player)

    if storage.owner ~= citizenid then
        MySQL.query(
            'INSERT IGNORE INTO zodi4c_storage_members (storage_id, citizenid, name) VALUES (?, ?, ?)',
            { storageId, citizenid, charName }
        )
    end

    local stashName = STASH_PREFIX .. storage.id
    exports.ox_inventory:RegisterStash(stashName, storage.name, storage.slots, storage.weight, false)
    TriggerClientEvent('zodi4c-storage:client:openStash', src, stashName)

    LogAction(storageId, citizenid, charName, 'access', 'storage_open')
end

-- Returns every storage so players can discover and join new ones.
QBCore.Functions.CreateCallback('zodi4c-storage:server:getStorages', function(source, cb)
    local player = QBCore.Functions.GetPlayer(source)
    if not player then return cb({}) end

    local nearOk = IsPlayerNearStorage(source, player)
    if not nearOk then return cb({}) end

    local citizenid = player.PlayerData.citizenid
    local query = [[
        SELECT
            s.id,
            s.owner,
            s.name,
            s.image,
            s.slots,
            s.weight,
            s.created_at,
            s.updated_at,
            CASE WHEN s.password IS NOT NULL AND s.password <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS password,
            CASE WHEN s.owner = ? THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS isOwner,
            CASE WHEN m.citizenid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS isMember
        FROM zodi4c_storages s
        LEFT JOIN zodi4c_storage_members m
            ON s.id = m.storage_id
            AND m.citizenid COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci = ?
    ]]

    MySQL.query(query, { citizenid, citizenid }, function(results)
        results = results or {}

        for _, storage in ipairs(results) do
            storage.password = storage.password == 1
            storage.isOwner = storage.isOwner == 1
            storage.isMember = storage.isMember == 1
        end

        cb(results)
    end)
end)

RegisterNetEvent('zodi4c-storage:server:createStorage', function(data)
    local src = source
    local player = QBCore.Functions.GetPlayer(src)
    if not player then return end

    local nearOk, nearErr = IsPlayerNearStorage(src, player)
    if not nearOk then
        Notify(src, nearErr, 'error')
        return
    end

    if type(data) ~= 'table' or not data.name or not data.slots or not data.weight then
        Notify(src, 'missing_data', 'error')
        return
    end

    local citizenid = player.PlayerData.citizenid
    local name = NormalizeName(data.name)
    local slots = tonumber(data.slots)
    local weight = tonumber(data.weight)
    slots = slots and math.floor(slots) or nil
    weight = weight and math.floor(weight) or nil
    local image, imageValid = SanitizeImageUrl(data.image)
    local paymentType = (data.paymentType == 'bank' or data.paymentType == 'cash') and data.paymentType or 'cash'
    local price = tonumber(Config.Pricing[paymentType]) or 0
    local rawPassword = data.password and tostring(data.password) or ''

    if not imageValid then
        Notify(src, 'invalid_image_url', 'error')
        return
    end

    if not slots or slots < 1 or slots > (Config.Limits.maxSlots or 100) then
        Notify(src, 'invalid_slots', 'error')
        return
    end

    if not weight or weight < 1000 or weight > (Config.Limits.maxWeight or 500000) then
        Notify(src, 'invalid_weight', 'error')
        return
    end

    if #name < (Config.Limits.minNameLength or 3) then
        Notify(src, 'name_too_short', 'error', Config.Limits.minNameLength or 3)
        return
    end

    local passwordValid, passwordKey, passwordLimit = ValidatePassword(rawPassword)
    if not passwordValid then
        Notify(src, passwordKey, 'error', passwordLimit)
        return
    end

    if not AcquireActionLock(src, 'createStorage') then
        Notify(src, 'action_in_progress', 'error')
        return
    end

    local password = NormalizePassword(rawPassword)

    local function CreateStorage()
        MySQL.scalar('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM zodi4c_storages WHERE owner = ?', { citizenid }, function(count)
            if (count or 0) >= (Config.Limits.maxStoragesPerPlayer or 10) then
                ReleaseActionLock(src, 'createStorage')
                Notify(src, 'max_storages_reached', 'error', Config.Limits.maxStoragesPerPlayer or 10)
                return
            end

            if player.Functions.GetMoney(paymentType) < price then
                ReleaseActionLock(src, 'createStorage')
                Notify(src, 'not_enough_money', 'error')
                return
            end

            player.Functions.RemoveMoney(paymentType, price, 'storage-creation')

            MySQL.insert(
                'INSERT INTO zodi4c_storages (owner, name, image, slots, weight, password) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)',
                { citizenid, name, image, slots, weight, password },
                function(id)
                    ReleaseActionLock(src, 'createStorage')
                    if not id then
                        player.Functions.AddMoney(paymentType, price, 'storage-creation-refund')
                        Notify(src, 'storage_create_failed', 'error')
                        return
                    end

                    Notify(src, 'storage_created', 'success')
                    TriggerClientEvent('zodi4c-storage:client:refreshStorages', src)
                end
            )
        end)
    end

    if Config.Features.requireUniqueNames then
        MySQL.scalar('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM zodi4c_storages WHERE name = ?', { name }, function(count)
            if count and count > 0 then
                ReleaseActionLock(src, 'createStorage')
                Notify(src, 'storage_name_taken', 'error')
                return
            end

            CreateStorage()
        end)
    else
        CreateStorage()
    end
end)

RegisterNetEvent('zodi4c-storage:server:openStorage', function(storageId, password)
    local src = source
    local player = QBCore.Functions.GetPlayer(src)
    if not player then return end

    local nearOk, nearErr = IsPlayerNearStorage(src, player)
    if not nearOk then
        Notify(src, nearErr, 'error')
        return
    end

    storageId = tonumber(storageId)
    if not storageId then return end

    if not AcquireActionLock(src, 'openStorage') then
        return
    end

    local citizenid = player.PlayerData.citizenid

    MySQL.single('SELECT * FROM zodi4c_storages WHERE id = ?', { storageId }, function(storage)
        if not storage then
            ReleaseActionLock(src, 'openStorage')
            Notify(src, 'storage_not_found', 'error')
            return
        end

        if storage.owner == citizenid then
            ReleaseActionLock(src, 'openStorage')
            OpenStash(src, storageId, storage)
            return
        end

        MySQL.scalar(
            'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM zodi4c_storage_members WHERE storage_id = ? AND citizenid = ?',
            { storageId, citizenid },
            function(memberCount)
                if memberCount and memberCount > 0 then
                    ReleaseActionLock(src, 'openStorage')
                    OpenStash(src, storageId, storage)
                    return
                end

                if storage.password and storage.password ~= '' then
                    local loginState = GetLoginState(citizenid)
                    if loginState and loginState.lockedUntil then
                        ReleaseActionLock(src, 'openStorage')
                        Notify(src, 'too_many_attempts', 'error', loginState.lockedUntil - os.time())
                        return
                    end

                    if not VerifyPassword(storage.password, password) then
                        local failedState = RegisterFailedAttempt(citizenid)
                        ReleaseActionLock(src, 'openStorage')
                        if failedState.lockedUntil then
                            Notify(src, 'locked_out', 'error', Config.Security.lockoutDuration or 300)
                        else
                            Notify(src, 'wrong_password', 'error')
                        end
                        return
                    end

                    loginAttempts[citizenid] = nil
                end

                ReleaseActionLock(src, 'openStorage')
                OpenStash(src, storageId, storage)
            end
        )
    end)
end)

QBCore.Functions.CreateCallback('zodi4c-storage:server:getMembers', function(source, cb, storageId)
    local src = source
    local player = QBCore.Functions.GetPlayer(src)
    if not player then return cb({}) end

    local nearOk = IsPlayerNearStorage(src, player)
    if not nearOk then return cb({}) end

    storageId = tonumber(storageId)
    if not storageId then return cb({}) end

    MySQL.single([[
        SELECT s.owner, p.charinfo
        FROM zodi4c_storages s
        LEFT JOIN players p
            ON s.owner COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci = p.citizenid COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci
        WHERE s.id = ?
    ]], { storageId }, function(storage)
        if not storage or storage.owner ~= player.PlayerData.citizenid then
            return cb({})
        end

        local ownerName = L('unknown_owner')
        if storage.charinfo then
            local charinfo = storage.charinfo
            if type(charinfo) == 'string' then
                local ok, decoded = pcall(json.decode, charinfo)
                charinfo = ok and decoded or nil
            end
            if type(charinfo) == 'table' and charinfo.firstname then
                ownerName = ('%s %s'):format(charinfo.firstname, charinfo.lastname or '')
            end
        end

        MySQL.query([[
            SELECT m.citizenid, m.name AS cached_name, p.charinfo
            FROM zodi4c_storage_members m
            LEFT JOIN players p
                ON m.citizenid COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci = p.citizenid COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci
            WHERE m.storage_id = ?
        ]], { storageId }, function(memberResults)
            local members = {
                {
                    citizenid = storage.owner,
                    name = ownerName,
                    isOwner = true
                }
            }

            for _, member in ipairs(memberResults or {}) do
                if member.citizenid ~= storage.owner then
                    local name = member.cached_name or L('unknown_member')

                    if member.charinfo then
                        local charinfo = member.charinfo
                        if type(charinfo) == 'string' then
                            local ok, decoded = pcall(json.decode, charinfo)
                            charinfo = ok and decoded or nil
                        end
                        if type(charinfo) == 'table' and charinfo.firstname then
                            name = ('%s %s'):format(charinfo.firstname, charinfo.lastname or '')
                        end
                    end

                    members[#members + 1] = {
                        citizenid = member.citizenid,
                        name = name,
                        isOwner = false
                    }
                end
            end

            cb(members)
        end)
    end)
end)

RegisterNetEvent('zodi4c-storage:server:deleteStorage', function(storageId)
    local src = source
    local player = QBCore.Functions.GetPlayer(src)
    if not player then return end

    local nearOk, nearErr = IsPlayerNearStorage(src, player)
    if not nearOk then
        Notify(src, nearErr, 'error')
        return
    end

    storageId = tonumber(storageId)
    if not storageId then return end

    MySQL.single('SELECT owner, name, slots, weight FROM zodi4c_storages WHERE id = ?', { storageId }, function(storage)
        if not storage or storage.owner ~= player.PlayerData.citizenid then
            Notify(src, 'no_permission', 'error')
            return
        end

        local stashName = STASH_PREFIX .. storageId
        -- Ensure stash is registered/loaded by ox_inventory before checking item count after restart.
        exports.ox_inventory:RegisterStash(stashName, storage.name, storage.slots, storage.weight, false)
        local inventory = exports.ox_inventory:GetInventory(stashName)

        if inventory and inventory.items then
            for _, item in pairs(inventory.items) do
                if item and (item.count or 0) > 0 then
                    Notify(src, 'storage_has_items', 'error')
                    return
                end
            end
        end

        local function PerformDelete()
            MySQL.query('DELETE FROM ox_inventory WHERE name = ?', { stashName })
            MySQL.query('DELETE FROM zodi4c_storages WHERE id = ?', { storageId }, function()
                Notify(src, 'storage_deleted', 'success')
                TriggerClientEvent('zodi4c-storage:client:refreshStorages', src)
            end)
        end

        if not inventory then
            MySQL.scalar('SELECT data FROM ox_inventory WHERE name = ?', { stashName }, function(rawData)
                if rawData and rawData ~= '' and rawData ~= '[]' and rawData ~= '{}' then
                    local ok, decoded = pcall(json.decode, rawData)
                    if ok and type(decoded) == 'table' then
                        for _, item in pairs(decoded) do
                            if type(item) == 'table' and (tonumber(item.count) or 0) > 0 then
                                Notify(src, 'storage_has_items', 'error')
                                return
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                PerformDelete()
            end)
            return
        end

        PerformDelete()
    end)
end)

-- resource.lua -- load a real FiveM resource's scripts into the stubbed environment.
--
--   local natives  = require('helpers.natives')
--   local resource = require('helpers.resource')
--
--   natives.reset()
--   local res = resource.load_resource('packages/my-resource', 'client')
--   natives.advance(0)              -- run threads the scripts created
--
-- load_resource(dir, side, opts) reads <dir>/fxmanifest.lua with a small declarative parser (it never
-- executes the manifest), then runs shared scripts followed by <side> scripts, each list in manifest
-- order -- the same order FiveM uses. Every script shares _G, as scripts of one resource do in FiveM.
--
-- opts:
--   name      resource name for GetCurrentResourceName() (default: manifest `name`, else folder name)
--   reset     natives.reset() options; when given, the harness is reset before loading
--   skip      { ['path/in/manifest.lua'] = true } -- entries not to run
--   externals { ['@ox_lib/init.lua'] = 'path/on/disk.lua' } -- '@resource/file' entries; unmapped ones
--             are skipped and listed in result.skipped
--
-- Returns { name, dir, side, manifest, loaded = { paths }, skipped = { entries }, exports = { ... } }.

-- Load natives.lua next to this file, whatever module prefix the caller used to require us.
local prefix = (...) and (...):match('^(.-)[^%.]+$') or ''
local natives = require(prefix .. 'natives')

local M = {}

local LIST_KEYS = {
    client_script = 'client', client_scripts = 'client',
    server_script = 'server', server_scripts = 'server',
    shared_script = 'shared', shared_scripts = 'shared',
    file = 'files', files = 'files',
    dependency = 'dependencies', dependencies = 'dependencies',
}
local SCALAR_KEYS = {
    fx_version = true, game = true, lua54 = true, name = true, author = true,
    description = true, version = true, ui_page = true, loadscreen = true, repository = true,
}

local function read_file(path)
    local f = io.open(path, 'rb')
    if not f then return nil end
    local body = f:read('*a') -- '*a' (not 'a') keeps Lua 5.1 happy
    f:close()
    return body
end

local function blank(s) return (s:gsub('[^\n]', ' ')) end

local function strip_comments(src)
    -- block comments: --[[ ]] and --[==[ ]==]
    src = src:gsub('(%-%-%[(=*)%[.-%]%2%])', blank)
    -- line comments
    src = src:gsub('%-%-[^\n]*', blank)
    return src
end

local function strings_in(s)
    local out = {}
    local pos = 1
    while true do
        local q1, q2 = s:find('[\'"]', pos)
        if not q1 then break end
        local quote = s:sub(q1, q1)
        local close = s:find(quote, q2 + 1, true)
        if not close then break end
        out[#out + 1] = s:sub(q1 + 1, close - 1)
        pos = close + 1
    end
    return out
end

--- Parse fxmanifest.lua source. Understands `key 'v'`, `key "v"` and `key { 'a', "b" }` (multi-line).
--- Returns { client = {}, server = {}, shared = {}, files = {}, dependencies = {}, <scalar keys> }.
function M.parse_manifest(src)
    local text = strip_comments(src)
    local m = { client = {}, server = {}, shared = {}, files = {}, dependencies = {} }
    local pos = 1
    while true do
        local s, e, key, open = text:find('([%a_][%w_]*)%s*([{\'"])', pos)
        if not s then break end
        local value, stop
        if open == '{' then
            local close = text:find('}', e + 1, true)
            if not close then break end
            value, stop = text:sub(e, close), close
        else
            local close = text:find(open, e + 1, true)
            local nl = text:find('\n', e + 1, true)
            if not close or (nl and nl < close) then
                pos = e + 1
                value = nil
            else
                value, stop = text:sub(e, close), close
            end
        end
        if value then
            local list = LIST_KEYS[key]
            if list then
                for _, v in ipairs(strings_in(value)) do m[list][#m[list] + 1] = v end
            elseif SCALAR_KEYS[key] then
                m[key] = strings_in(value)[1]
            end
            pos = stop + 1
        end
    end
    return m
end

--- Read and parse <dir>/fxmanifest.lua.
function M.read_manifest(dir)
    local path = dir .. '/fxmanifest.lua'
    local src = read_file(path)
    if not src then error('no fxmanifest.lua in ' .. tostring(dir), 2) end
    return M.parse_manifest(src)
end

local function glob_to_pattern(seg)
    return '^' .. seg:gsub('[%^%$%(%)%%%.%[%]%+%-%?]', '%%%0'):gsub('%*', '.*') .. '$'
end

-- Expand one manifest entry ('client/*.lua' style globs in the last path segment only).
local function expand(dir, entry)
    if not entry:find('*', 1, true) then return { entry } end
    if entry:find('**', 1, true) then
        error('load_resource: recursive glob not supported: ' .. entry, 3)
    end
    local ok, lfs = pcall(require, 'lfs')
    if not ok then
        error('load_resource: glob ' .. entry .. ' needs luafilesystem (luarocks install luafilesystem)', 3)
    end
    local sub, seg = entry:match('^(.*)/([^/]*)$')
    if not sub then sub, seg = '', entry end
    if sub:find('*', 1, true) then
        error('load_resource: glob only supported in the file name: ' .. entry, 3)
    end
    local base = sub == '' and dir or (dir .. '/' .. sub)
    local pat = glob_to_pattern(seg)
    local out = {}
    if lfs.attributes(base, 'mode') ~= 'directory' then return out end
    for f in lfs.dir(base) do
        if f ~= '.' and f ~= '..' and f:match(pat) and lfs.attributes(base .. '/' .. f, 'mode') == 'file' then
            out[#out + 1] = (sub == '' and f) or (sub .. '/' .. f)
        end
    end
    table.sort(out)
    return out
end

local function run_file(path)
    local before = {}
    for k in pairs(_G) do before[k] = true end
    local chunk, err = loadfile(path)
    if not chunk then
        error(('load_resource: cannot load %s: %s\n(CfxLua-only syntax such as `backtick` hashes or '
            .. '<const> does not load in stock Lua -- see busted/README.md)'):format(path, tostring(err)), 0)
    end
    chunk()
    -- globals a resource script defines are removed by the next natives.reset()
    for k in pairs(_G) do
        if not before[k] and type(k) == 'string' then natives.track_global(k) end
    end
end

--- Load a resource directory for `side` ('client' or 'server') into the stubbed environment.
function M.load_resource(dir, side, opts)
    opts = opts or {}
    side = side or 'server'
    if side ~= 'client' and side ~= 'server' then
        error("load_resource: side must be 'client' or 'server'", 2)
    end
    dir = dir:gsub('/+$', '')
    local manifest = M.read_manifest(dir)
    local name = opts.name or manifest.name or dir:match('([^/]+)$')

    if opts.reset then
        local r = {}
        for k, v in pairs(opts.reset) do r[k] = v end
        r.resource, r.side = r.resource or name, r.side or side
        natives.reset(r)
    else
        natives.set_resource(name)
        natives.state().side = side
    end

    local result = { name = name, dir = dir, side = side, manifest = manifest, loaded = {}, skipped = {} }
    local skip = opts.skip or {}
    local externals = opts.externals or {}

    local function run_list(list)
        for _, entry in ipairs(list) do
            if entry:sub(1, 1) == '@' then
                local mapped = externals[entry]
                if mapped then
                    run_file(mapped)
                    result.loaded[#result.loaded + 1] = mapped
                else
                    result.skipped[#result.skipped + 1] = entry
                end
            elseif skip[entry] then
                result.skipped[#result.skipped + 1] = entry
            else
                for _, rel in ipairs(expand(dir, entry)) do
                    if rel:match('%.lua$') then
                        run_file(dir .. '/' .. rel)
                        result.loaded[#result.loaded + 1] = rel
                    else
                        result.skipped[#result.skipped + 1] = rel -- JS/C# scripts are not runnable here
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    run_list(manifest.shared)
    run_list(manifest[side])
    result.exports = natives.exports_of(name)
    return result
end

return M

-- LD CarWhitelist (server): works out who may use which group, enforces it, logs, checks for updates.

local RESOURCE = GetCurrentResourceName()
local VERSION = GetResourceMetadata(RESOURCE, 'version', 0) or '0.0.0'
local PREFIX = '^5LD CarWhitelist^7'
local STATE = 'ldcwAccess'          -- Player(src).state: { bypass = bool, groups = { group indexes } }
local BYPASS_VEHICLE = 'ldCarwhitelistBypass'

-- Vehicles that everyone may use, set by server scripts through the setVehicleBypass export.
-- The server only trusts this list: the owner of a vehicle (the player driving it) can write the
-- vehicle's state bag, so a cheater could set the state bag value on a locked vehicle himself.
local bypassVehicles = {}

local function log(tag, fmt, ...) print(('%s %s %s^0'):format(PREFIX, tag, fmt:format(...))) end
local function ok(...) log('^2  OK ^7', ...) end
local function info(...) log('^7 INFO^7', ...) end
local function warn(...) log('^3 WARN^7', ...) end
local function hint(...) log('^6 HINT^7', ...) end
local function debug(...) if Config.Debug then log('^8DEBUG^7', ...) end end

local function started(res)
    local s = GetResourceState(res)
    return s == 'started' or s == 'starting'
end

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Framework: the player's job as { name, grade, onDuty }
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local framework, ESX, QBCore

local function detect()
    if started('es_extended') then
        local okExport, obj = pcall(function() return exports.es_extended:getSharedObject() end)
        if okExport and obj then ESX = obj; return 'esx' end
    end
    if started('qbx_core') then return 'qbx' end
    if started('qb-core') then
        local okExport, obj = pcall(function() return exports['qb-core']:GetCoreObject() end)
        if okExport and obj then QBCore = obj; return 'qb' end
    end
    return 'none'
end

local function jobOf(src)
    local okJob, job = pcall(function()
        if framework == 'esx' then
            local xPlayer = ESX.GetPlayerFromId(src)
            local j = xPlayer and xPlayer.job
            if j then return { name = j.name, grade = j.grade, onDuty = j.onDuty } end
        elseif framework == 'qbx' then
            local player = exports.qbx_core:GetPlayer(src)
            local j = player and player.PlayerData and player.PlayerData.job
            if j then return { name = j.name, grade = type(j.grade) == 'table' and j.grade.level or j.grade, onDuty = j.onduty } end
        elseif framework == 'qb' then
            local player = QBCore.Functions.GetPlayer(src)
            local j = player and player.PlayerData and player.PlayerData.job
            if j then return { name = j.name, grade = type(j.grade) == 'table' and j.grade.level or j.grade, onDuty = j.onduty } end
        end
    end)
    if okJob then return job end
    debug('Could not read the job of %s: %s', tostring(src), tostring(job))
end

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Access per player
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local access = {}   -- src -> { bypass = bool, set = { [gi] = true }, groups = { gi, ... } }

local function compute(src)
    local bypass = Config.BypassAce and IsPlayerAceAllowed(src, Config.BypassAce) or false
    local job = jobOf(src)
    local set, list = {}, {}
    for gi, group in ipairs(Config.Groups or {}) do
        local allowed = bypass or Rules.jobAllows(group, job) or (group.ace and IsPlayerAceAllowed(src, group.ace))
        if allowed then set[gi] = true; list[#list + 1] = gi end
    end
    return { bypass = bypass, set = set, groups = list }
end

--- Work out the player's access again and share it with their game.
local function refresh(src)
    src = tonumber(src)
    if not src or not GetPlayerName(src) then return end
    local a = compute(src)
    local prev = access[src]
    access[src] = a
    if not prev or prev.bypass ~= a.bypass or table.concat(prev.groups, ',') ~= table.concat(a.groups, ',') then
        Player(src).state:set(STATE, { bypass = a.bypass, groups = a.groups }, true)
        debug('Access of %s: %s%s', GetPlayerName(src), a.bypass and 'bypass ' or '', table.concat(a.groups, ','))
    end
end

local function refreshAll()
    for _, id in ipairs(GetPlayers()) do refresh(id) end
end

-- job and duty changes (and loading a character) update right away
AddEventHandler('esx:setJob', function(src) refresh(src) end)
AddEventHandler('esx:playerLoaded', function(src) refresh(src) end)
AddEventHandler('QBCore:Server:OnJobUpdate', function(src) refresh(src) end)
AddEventHandler('QBCore:Server:SetDuty', function(src) refresh(src) end)
AddEventHandler('QBCore:Server:OnPlayerUpdated', function(src, key) -- newer qb-core versions
    if key == 'job' or key == nil then refresh(src) end
end)
AddEventHandler('QBCore:Server:PlayerLoaded', function(player)
    refresh(type(player) == 'table' and player.PlayerData and player.PlayerData.source or player)
end)
AddEventHandler('playerJoining', function()
    local src = source -- `source` is gone inside the timeout
    SetTimeout(1000, function() refresh(src) end)
end)
local lastLog, removing = {}, {}
AddEventHandler('playerDropped', function()
    access[source], lastLog[source], removing[source] = nil, nil, nil -- server ids are reused
end)

--- Groups with `classes`: the server can't read a vehicle's class, so it can't tell whether such a group covers
--- the vehicle. If the player has access to one of them, the server lets the game decide. That way the server
--- never removes someone the game would allow.
local function hasClassGroup(set)
    for gi in pairs(set) do
        local g = Config.Groups[gi]
        if g and type(g.classes) == 'table' and #g.classes > 0 then return true end
    end
    return false
end

--- May this player use this vehicle seat? Returns true, or false plus the group that locks it.
local function mayUse(src, vehicle, seat)
    if bypassVehicles[vehicle] and DoesEntityExist(vehicle) then return true end
    local a = access[src] or compute(src)
    if a.bypass then return true end
    local group = Rules.lockedBy(Rules.groupsFor(GetEntityModel(vehicle)), a.set, seat)
    if group and hasClassGroup(a.set) then return true end
    if group then return false, group end
    return true
end

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Discord log
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function webhook(src, group, what)
    local url = GetConvar('ldcwl_webhook', '')
    if url == '' then url = (Config.Webhook and Config.Webhook.Url) or '' end
    if url == '' then return end
    local now = os.time()
    if lastLog[src] and now - lastLog[src] < ((Config.Webhook and Config.Webhook.Cooldown) or 60) then return end
    lastLog[src] = now

    local job = jobOf(src)
    PerformHttpRequest(url, function() end, 'POST', json.encode({
        username = 'LD CarWhitelist',
        embeds = { {
            title = what,
            color = 15105570,
            fields = {
                { name = 'Player', value = ('%s (%d)'):format(GetPlayerName(src) or 'unknown', src), inline = true },
                { name = 'Vehicle group', value = Rules.label(group), inline = true },
                { name = 'Job', value = job and ('%s %s'):format(tostring(job.name), tostring(job.grade)) or 'unknown', inline = true },
            },
            footer = { text = 'LD CarWhitelist' },
            timestamp = os.date('!%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ'),
        } },
    }), { ['Content-Type'] = 'application/json' })
end

-- The game reports a blocked attempt (only used for the log; checked again here, never trusted).
RegisterNetEvent('ld_carwhitelist:attempt', function(netId, seat)
    local src = source
    if not (Config.Webhook and Config.Webhook.LogAttempts) then return end
    local vehicle = NetworkGetEntityFromNetworkId(tonumber(netId) or 0)
    if not vehicle or vehicle == 0 or not DoesEntityExist(vehicle) then return end
    local allowed, group = mayUse(src, vehicle, tonumber(seat) or -1)
    if not allowed then webhook(src, group, 'Tried to get into a locked vehicle') end
end)

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Server check: remove players without access from locked seats
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function seatOf(ped, vehicle)
    for seat = -1, 15 do
        if GetPedInVehicleSeat(vehicle, seat) == ped then return seat end
    end
end

local AIRCRAFT = { heli = true, plane = true, blimp = true }
local SAFE_SPEED = 3.0 -- m/s: only remove someone from a vehicle that is (nearly) standing still

local function enforce()
    for _, id in ipairs(GetPlayers()) do
        local src = tonumber(id)
        local ped = GetPlayerPed(src)
        local vehicle = ped and ped ~= 0 and GetVehiclePedIsIn(ped, false) or 0
        local seat = vehicle ~= 0 and seatOf(ped, vehicle)
        local allowed, group = true, nil
        if seat then allowed, group = mayUse(src, vehicle, seat) end

        if allowed then
            removing[src] = nil
        else
            -- never throw someone out of a flying aircraft or a moving car; wait until it stops
            local moving = GetEntitySpeed(vehicle) > SAFE_SPEED
            local aircraft = AIRCRAFT[tostring(GetVehicleType(vehicle))]
            if not moving and not (aircraft and GetEntitySpeed(vehicle) > 0.5) then
                TaskLeaveVehicle(ped, vehicle, 0)
            end
            if removing[src] ~= vehicle then -- log and notify once per vehicle, not every check
                removing[src] = vehicle
                TriggerClientEvent('ld_carwhitelist:removed', src, Rules.label(group))
                info('%s (%d) is in a locked %s vehicle without access%s.', GetPlayerName(src) or '?', src,
                    Rules.label(group), moving and ', removed once it stops' or '')
                webhook(src, group, 'In a locked vehicle without access')
            end
        end
    end
end

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Exports
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--- exports.ld_carwhitelist:hasAccess(source, modelOrVehicle) -> true | false, groupLabel
exports('hasAccess', function(src, model)
    src = tonumber(src)
    if not src or not GetPlayerName(src) then return false end
    if type(model) == 'string' then model = joaat(model) end
    if model and DoesEntityExist(model) and GetEntityType(model) == 2 then -- a vehicle entity
        local allowed, group = mayUse(src, model, -1)
        return allowed, group and group.label
    end
    local a = access[src] or compute(src)
    if a.bypass then return true end
    local group = Rules.lockedBy(Rules.groupsFor(model), a.set, -1)
    return group == nil, group and group.label
end)

--- exports.ld_carwhitelist:refreshPlayer(source) - after you changed a job or permission yourself
exports('refreshPlayer', function(src) refresh(src) end)

--- exports.ld_carwhitelist:setVehicleBypass(vehicle, true|false) - let everyone use one vehicle (server only)
exports('setVehicleBypass', function(vehicle, enabled)
    vehicle = tonumber(vehicle)
    if not vehicle or not DoesEntityExist(vehicle) or GetEntityType(vehicle) ~= 2 then return false end
    bypassVehicles[vehicle] = enabled and true or nil
    Entity(vehicle).state:set(BYPASS_VEHICLE, enabled and true or nil, true) -- so the client side agrees
    return true
end)

AddEventHandler('entityRemoved', function(entity) bypassVehicles[entity] = nil end)

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Update check: reads the latest release from GitHub once a day. Nothing about your server is sent.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local RELEASES = 'https://api.github.com/repos/LucaNL/LD-CarWhitelist/releases/latest'
local DOWNLOAD = 'https://github.com/LucaNL/LD-CarWhitelist/releases/latest'
local announced

local function parse(v)
    local a, b, c = tostring(v or ''):match('^v?(%d+)%.(%d+)%.?(%d*)')
    if a then return { tonumber(a), tonumber(b), tonumber(c) or 0 } end
end

local function newer(latest, current)
    local x, y = parse(latest), parse(current)
    if not x or not y then return false end
    for i = 1, 3 do if x[i] ~= y[i] then return x[i] > y[i] end end
    return false
end

local function checkVersion()
    PerformHttpRequest(RELEASES, function(status, body)
        if status ~= 200 or type(body) ~= 'string' then return end
        local okDecode, data = pcall(json.decode, body)
        local latest = okDecode and type(data) == 'table' and data.tag_name
        if latest and newer(latest, VERSION) and announced ~= latest then
            announced = latest
            warn('Update available: v%s → %s', VERSION, latest)
            hint('Download: %s (keep your config.lua).', DOWNLOAD)
        end
    end, 'GET', '', { ['Accept'] = 'application/vnd.github+json', ['User-Agent'] = RESOURCE })
end

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Startup
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
CreateThread(function()
    Wait(0)
    framework = detect()
    Rules.build()
    local models = 0
    for _ in pairs(Rules.build().byModel) do models = models + 1 end
    ok('v%s started: %d group(s), %d model(s) · framework %s · server check %s', VERSION, #(Config.Groups or {}), models,
        framework == 'none' and 'none (ACE only)' or framework, Config.ServerCheck ~= false and 'on' or 'off')
    refreshAll()

    if Config.VersionCheck ~= false then SetTimeout(5000, checkVersion) end

    local sinceRefresh, sinceVersion = 0, 0
    local interval = math.max(500, tonumber(Config.ServerCheckInterval) or 1500)
    while true do
        Wait(interval)
        sinceRefresh = sinceRefresh + interval
        sinceVersion = sinceVersion + interval
        if sinceRefresh >= 15000 then sinceRefresh = 0; refreshAll() end -- catches job changes without events
        if Config.ServerCheck ~= false then
            local okRun, err = pcall(enforce)
            if not okRun then warn('Server check failed: %s', tostring(err)) end
        end
        if Config.VersionCheck ~= false and sinceVersion >= 86400000 then sinceVersion = 0; checkVersion() end
    end
end)

-- a restart of the framework resets the shared object
AddEventHandler('onResourceStart', function(res)
    if res == 'es_extended' or res == 'qb-core' or res == 'qbx_core' then
        SetTimeout(2000, function() framework = detect(); refreshAll() end)
    end
end)

-- The rules, shared by client and server. Pure functions apart from joaat.

Rules = {}

local index -- built once: model hash -> { group indexes }, class -> { group indexes }

--- Natives return signed hashes; a pasted unsigned one (e.g. 2046537925) would never match. Use signed everywhere.
local function signed(hash)
    hash = tonumber(hash) or 0
    if hash > 0x7FFFFFFF then hash = hash - 0x100000000 end
    return hash
end

function Rules.build()
    index = { byModel = {}, byClass = {} }
    for gi, group in ipairs(type(Config.Groups) == 'table' and Config.Groups or {}) do
        for _, model in ipairs(type(group.models) == 'table' and group.models or {}) do
            local hash = signed(type(model) == 'number' and model or joaat(tostring(model)))
            index.byModel[hash] = index.byModel[hash] or {}
            table.insert(index.byModel[hash], gi)
        end
        for _, class in ipairs(type(group.classes) == 'table' and group.classes or {}) do
            class = tonumber(class)
            if class then
                index.byClass[class] = index.byClass[class] or {}
                table.insert(index.byClass[class], gi)
            end
        end
    end
    return index
end

--- Group indexes that contain this vehicle (by model, and by class when a class is given).
function Rules.groupsFor(model, class)
    if not index then Rules.build() end
    local out, seen = {}, {}
    for _, list in ipairs({ index.byModel[signed(model)] or {}, class and index.byClass[class] or {} }) do
        for _, gi in ipairs(list) do
            if not seen[gi] then seen[gi] = true; out[#out + 1] = gi end
        end
    end
    return out
end

--- Does this job give access to the group? job = { name, grade, onDuty } (onDuty nil = unknown, counts as on duty)
function Rules.jobAllows(group, job)
    if type(job) ~= 'table' or not job.name or type(group.jobs) ~= 'table' then return false end
    local minGrade = group.jobs[job.name]
    if minGrade == nil then return false end
    if minGrade == true then minGrade = 0 end
    if (tonumber(job.grade) or 0) < (tonumber(minGrade) or 0) then return false end
    if group.onDuty and job.onDuty == false then return false end
    return true
end

--- Is this seat locked for a player who has access to the groups in `allowed` (set of group indexes)?
--- Returns nil when the player may use it, otherwise the group that locks it (for its label).
function Rules.lockedBy(groups, allowed, seat)
    if #groups == 0 then return nil end
    for _, gi in ipairs(groups) do
        if allowed and allowed[gi] then return nil end -- access to any of the groups is enough
    end
    for _, gi in ipairs(groups) do
        local group = Config.Groups[gi]
        if group.seats == 'all' or seat == -1 then return group end
    end
    return nil
end

--- Label of a group for messages.
function Rules.label(group)
    return group and group.label or 'authorised staff'
end

local type = type
local error = error
local tostring = tostring
local xpcall = xpcall
local traceback = debug.traceback
local format = string.format

local factories = {}
local states = {}
local values = {}

if __luat ~= nil then
    error('LuaT runtime namespace "__luat" is already in use', 0)
end

local function validateId(id)
    if type(id) ~= 'string' or id == '' then
        error('LuaT module id must be a non-empty string', 3)
    end
end

local function register(id, factory)
    validateId(id)

    if type(factory) ~= 'function' then
        error(format('LuaT module "%s" requires a factory function', id), 2)
    end

    if factories[id] ~= nil then
        error(format('LuaT module "%s" is already registered', id), 2)
    end

    factories[id] = factory
end

local function import(id)
    validateId(id)

    local state = states[id]

    if state == 'loaded' then
        return values[id]
    end

    if state == 'loading' then
        error(format('LuaT module "%s" is already loading', id), 2)
    end

    local factory = factories[id]

    if factory == nil then
        error(format('LuaT module "%s" is not registered', id), 2)
    end

    states[id] = 'loading'

    -- Only the first module result is retained, including nil.
    local ok, result = xpcall(factory, traceback)

    if not ok then
        states[id] = nil
        error(format('LuaT module "%s" failed:\n%s', id, tostring(result)), 2)
    end

    values[id] = result
    states[id] = 'loaded'

    return result
end

__luat = {
    register = register,
    import = import,
}
