local QBCore = exports['qb-core']:GetCoreObject()

local floors = {}   -- list from the server
local zones = {}    -- target zone names
local openFrom      -- floor id the panel was opened at
local busy = false

local function canUse(f)
    if not f.job then return true end
    local job = QBCore.Functions.GetPlayerData().job
    return job ~= nil and job.name == f.job and (job.grade and job.grade.level or 0) >= f.grade
end

local function findFloor(id)
    for _, f in ipairs(floors) do
        if f.id == id then return f end
    end
end

local function closePanel()
    openFrom = nil
    SetNuiFocus(false, false)
    SendNUIMessage({ action = 'close' })
end

local function openPanel(fromId)
    local from = findFloor(fromId)
    if not from or busy then return end
    local list = {}
    for _, f in ipairs(floors) do
        if f.elevator == from.elevator then
            list[#list + 1] = { id = f.id, label = f.label, z = f.z, locked = not canUse(f) }
        end
    end
    table.sort(list, function(a, b) return a.z > b.z end) -- highest floor on top
    openFrom = fromId
    SetNuiFocus(true, true)
    SendNUIMessage({ action = 'open', title = from.elevator, current = fromId, floors = list })
end

local function clearZones()
    for _, name in ipairs(zones) do exports['qb-target']:RemoveZone(name) end
    zones = {}
end

local function buildZones()
    clearZones()
    for _, f in ipairs(floors) do
        local name = 'ykc-elevator:' .. f.id
        local id = f.id
        exports['qb-target']:AddBoxZone(name, vector3(f.x, f.y, f.z), Config.Zone.length, Config.Zone.width, {
            name = name,
            heading = f.h,
            debugPoly = Config.Debug,
            minZ = f.z - 1.2,
            maxZ = f.z + 1.2,
        }, {
            options = {
                { icon = 'fas fa-elevator', label = 'Asansör: ' .. f.elevator, action = function() openPanel(id) end },
            },
            distance = Config.Distance,
        })
        zones[#zones + 1] = name
    end
end

local function setFloors(list)
    floors = type(list) == 'table' and list or {}
    if openFrom then closePanel() end
    buildZones()
end

local function ride(c)
    busy = true
    local ped = PlayerPedId()
    DoScreenFadeOut(Config.FadeTime)
    while not IsScreenFadedOut() do Wait(10) end
    FreezeEntityPosition(ped, true)
    RequestCollisionAtCoord(c.x, c.y, c.z)
    SetEntityCoords(ped, c.x, c.y, c.z, false, false, false, false)
    SetEntityHeading(ped, c.h)
    local deadline = GetGameTimer() + 5000
    while not HasCollisionLoadedAroundEntity(ped) and GetGameTimer() < deadline do Wait(50) end
    Wait(600)
    FreezeEntityPosition(ped, false)
    PlaySoundFrontend(-1, 'CONFIRM_BEEP', 'HUD_MINI_GAME_SOUNDSET', true)
    DoScreenFadeIn(Config.FadeTime)
    busy = false
end

RegisterNUICallback('select', function(data, cb)
    cb('ok')
    local from, to = openFrom, tonumber(data and data.id)
    closePanel()
    if not from or not to or to == from or busy then return end
    QBCore.Functions.TriggerCallback('ykc-elevator:server:use', function(ok, coords)
        if ok and coords then ride(coords) end
    end, from, to)
end)

RegisterNUICallback('close', function(_, cb)
    cb('ok')
    closePanel()
end)

RegisterNetEvent('ykc-elevator:client:floors', setFloors)

RegisterNetEvent('ykc-elevator:client:addDialog', function(names)
    local hint = #names > 0 and ('Mevcut: ' .. table.concat(names, ', ')) or 'Henüz asansör yok'
    local dialog = exports['qb-input']:ShowInput({
        header = 'Asansör katı ekle (durduğun yer + baktığın yön)',
        submitText = 'Kaydet',
        inputs = {
            { type = 'text', name = 'elevator', text = 'Asansör adı - ' .. hint, isRequired = true },
            { type = 'text', name = 'label', text = 'Kat adı (ör. Peron, Sokak, Çatı)', isRequired = true },
            { type = 'text', name = 'job', text = 'Meslek kilidi (boş = herkes, ör. police)' },
            { type = 'number', name = 'grade', text = 'Minimum rütbe (boş = 0)' },
        },
    })
    if not dialog then return end
    TriggerServerEvent('ykc-elevator:server:add', dialog)
end)

CreateThread(function()
    QBCore.Functions.TriggerCallback('ykc-elevator:server:floors', setFloors)
end)

AddEventHandler('onResourceStop', function(res)
    if res ~= GetCurrentResourceName() then return end
    clearZones()
    if openFrom then SetNuiFocus(false, false) end
    if busy then
        FreezeEntityPosition(PlayerPedId(), false)
        DoScreenFadeIn(0)
    end
end)

local QBCore = exports['qb-core']:GetCoreObject()

local floors = {}  -- [id] = { id, elevator, label, x, y, z, h, job, grade }
local lastUse = {} -- [src] = os.time()

local function notify(src, msg, kind)
    TriggerClientEvent('QBCore:Notify', src, msg, kind)
end

local function isAdmin(src)
    return QBCore.Functions.HasPermission(src, 'admin') or QBCore.Functions.HasPermission(src, 'god')
end

local function floorList()
    local list = {}
    for _, f in pairs(floors) do list[#list + 1] = f end
    return list
end

local function broadcast()
    TriggerClientEvent('ykc-elevator:client:floors', -1, floorList())
end

local function hasAccess(Player, f)
    if not f.job then return true end
    local job = Player.PlayerData.job
    return job ~= nil and job.name == f.job and (job.grade and job.grade.level or 0) >= f.grade
end

local function trim(s)
    if type(s) ~= 'string' then return nil end
    s = s:match('^%s*(.-)%s*$')
    if s == '' or #s > 64 then return nil end
    return s
end

MySQL.ready(function()
    MySQL.query.await([[
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ykc_elevator_floors (
            id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
            elevator VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
            label VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
            x DOUBLE NOT NULL, y DOUBLE NOT NULL, z DOUBLE NOT NULL, h DOUBLE NOT NULL,
            job VARCHAR(50) NULL,
            grade INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
        )
    ]])
    for _, r in ipairs(MySQL.query.await('SELECT * FROM ykc_elevator_floors') or {}) do
        floors[r.id] = {
            id = r.id, elevator = r.elevator, label = r.label,
            x = r.x, y = r.y, z = r.z, h = r.h,
            job = r.job, grade = r.grade or 0,
        }
    end
    broadcast()
end)

QBCore.Functions.CreateCallback('ykc-elevator:server:floors', function(_, cb)
    cb(floorList())
end)

QBCore.Functions.CreateCallback('ykc-elevator:server:use', function(src, cb, fromId, toId)
    local Player = QBCore.Functions.GetPlayer(src)
    local from, to = floors[tonumber(fromId)], floors[tonumber(toId)]
    if not Player or not from or not to or from.id == to.id or from.elevator ~= to.elevator then
        return cb(false)
    end
    local now = os.time()
    if lastUse[src] and now - lastUse[src] < Config.Cooldown then
        notify(src, 'Asansör zaten hareket ediyor, biraz bekle.', 'error')
        return cb(false)
    end
    local ped = GetPlayerPed(src)
    if #(GetEntityCoords(ped) - vector3(from.x, from.y, from.z)) > Config.MaxUseDistance then
        return cb(false)
    end
    if not hasAccess(Player, to) then
        notify(src, 'Bu kata erişim yetkin yok.', 'error')
        return cb(false)
    end
    lastUse[src] = now
    cb(true, { x = to.x, y = to.y, z = to.z, h = to.h })
end)

AddEventHandler('playerDropped', function()
    lastUse[source] = nil
end)

---------------------------------------------------------------- admin

QBCore.Commands.Add(Config.AddCommand, 'Durduğun yeri asansör katı olarak kaydet (Admin)', {}, false, function(src)
    local names, seen = {}, {}
    for _, f in pairs(floors) do
        if not seen[f.elevator] then
            seen[f.elevator] = true
            names[#names + 1] = f.elevator
        end
    end
    table.sort(names)
    TriggerClientEvent('ykc-elevator:client:addDialog', src, names)
end, 'admin')

RegisterNetEvent('ykc-elevator:server:add', function(data)
    local src = source
    if not isAdmin(src) or type(data) ~= 'table' then return end
    local elevator, label = trim(data.elevator), trim(data.label)
    if not elevator or not label then
        return notify(src, 'Asansör adı ve kat adı gerekli (en fazla 64 karakter).', 'error')
    end
    local job = trim(data.job)
    if job then
        job = job:lower()
        if not QBCore.Shared.Jobs[job] then
            return notify(src, ('"%s" diye bir meslek yok (qb-core/shared/jobs.lua).'):format(job), 'error')
        end
    end
    local grade = math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(data.grade) or 0))

    -- position comes from the server, never from the client
    local ped = GetPlayerPed(src)
    local c, h = GetEntityCoords(ped), GetEntityHeading(ped)
    local id = MySQL.insert.await(
        'INSERT INTO ykc_elevator_floors (elevator, label, x, y, z, h, job, grade) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)',
        { elevator, label, c.x, c.y, c.z, h, job, grade })
    if not id then return notify(src, 'Kaydedilemedi (DB hatası).', 'error') end
    floors[id] = { id = id, elevator = elevator, label = label, x = c.x, y = c.y, z = c.z, h = h, job = job, grade = grade }
    broadcast()
    local count = 0
    for _, f in pairs(floors) do if f.elevator == elevator then count = count + 1 end end
    notify(src, ('"%s" asansörüne "%s" katı eklendi (#%d, toplam %d kat).'):format(elevator, label, id, count), 'success')
end)

QBCore.Commands.Add(Config.RemoveCommand, 'Yakındaki asansör katını kaldır (Admin)', {}, false, function(src)
    local c = GetEntityCoords(GetPlayerPed(src))
    local best, bestD
    for id, f in pairs(floors) do
        local d = #(c - vector3(f.x, f.y, f.z))
        if d < 3.0 and (not bestD or d < bestD) then best, bestD = id, d end
    end
    if not best then return notify(src, '3 metre içinde asansör katı yok.', 'error') end
    local f = floors[best]
    MySQL.query.await('DELETE FROM ykc_elevator_floors WHERE id = ?', { best })
    floors[best] = nil
    broadcast()
    notify(src, ('"%s" asansöründen "%s" katı kaldırıldı (#%d).'):format(f.elevator, f.label, best), 'success')
end, 'admin')

local scriptname = GetCurrentResourceName()

local Template = {
    ServerState = {},
    PlayerState = {
        busy = false,
        uiOpen = false,
        uiReady = false,
        shopId = nil,
        nearShopId = nil,
    },
    Points = {},
    Blips = {},
}

function Template:Notify(label, notifyType)
    TriggerEvent("pNotify:SendNotification", {
        text = label,
        type = notifyType or "info",
    })
end

function Template:PostNUI(action, data)
    if not self.PlayerState.uiReady then
        return
    end
    SendNUIMessage({
        action = action,
        data = data,
    })
end

function Template:Start()
    while not Core.IsPlayerLoaded() do
        Wait(500)
    end
    for shopId, shop in pairs(Config.Shops) do
        self:CreatePoint(shopId, shop)
        if Config.General.blip.enabled and shop.blip then
            self:CreateBlip(shop)
        end
    end
end

function Template:CreatePoint(shopId, shop)
    local point = lib.points.new({
        coords = shop.coords,
        distance = Config.General.interact.draw_distance,
        shopId = shopId,
    })

    function point:onExit()
        Template:SetPrompt(self.shopId, false)
    end

    function point:nearby()
        local inRange = self.currentDistance <= Config.General.interact.distance
        Template:SetPrompt(self.shopId, inRange)
        if inRange and IsControlJustReleased(0, Config.General.interact.key) then
            Template:OpenShop(self.shopId)
        end
    end

    self.Points[#self.Points + 1] = point
end

function Template:CreateBlip(shop)
    local blip = AddBlipForCoord(shop.coords.x, shop.coords.y, shop.coords.z)
    SetBlipSprite(blip, shop.blip.sprite)
    SetBlipColour(blip, shop.blip.color)
    SetBlipScale(blip, shop.blip.scale + 0.0)
    SetBlipAsShortRange(blip, true)
    BeginTextCommandSetBlipName("STRING")
    AddTextComponentSubstringPlayerName(shop.label)
    EndTextCommandSetBlipName(blip)
    self.Blips[#self.Blips + 1] = blip
end

function Template:SetPrompt(shopId, visible)
    if visible and not self.PlayerState.uiOpen then
        if self.PlayerState.nearShopId ~= shopId then
            self.PlayerState.nearShopId = shopId
            BeginTextCommandDisplayHelp("STRING")
            AddTextComponentSubstringPlayerName(Config.Text.prompt_open)
            EndTextCommandDisplayHelp(0, false, true, -1)
        end
    elseif self.PlayerState.nearShopId == shopId then
        self.PlayerState.nearShopId = nil
        ClearAllHelpMessages()
    end
end

function Template:OpenShop(shopId)
    if self.PlayerState.busy or self.PlayerState.uiOpen then
        return
    end
    if IsPedDeadOrDying(cache.ped, true) or IsPedInAnyVehicle(cache.ped, false) then
        return
    end
    self.PlayerState.busy = true
    lib.callback(scriptname .. ":SV:getShop", false, function(ok, result)
        Template.PlayerState.busy = false
        if not ok then
            Template:Notify(result, "error")
            return
        end
        Template.PlayerState.shopId = shopId
        Template:SetUI(true, result)
    end, shopId)
end

function Template:SetUI(open, data)
    self.PlayerState.uiOpen = open
    SetNuiFocus(open, open)
    if open then
        if self.PlayerState.nearShopId then
            self.PlayerState.nearShopId = nil
            ClearAllHelpMessages()
        end
        TriggerScreenblurFadeIn(250)
        self:PostNUI("open", data)
    else
        self.PlayerState.shopId = nil
        TriggerScreenblurFadeOut(250)
        self:PostNUI("close")
    end
end

function Template:Buy(itemName, amount)
    local shopId = self.PlayerState.shopId
    if not shopId then
        return false
    end
    local ok, result = lib.callback.await(scriptname .. ":SV:buy", false, {
        shopId = shopId,
        item = itemName,
        amount = amount,
    })
    result = type(result) == "table" and result or {}
    self:Notify(result.message, ok and "success" or "error")
    return ok == true, result.money
end

function Template:OnReady(cb)
    self.PlayerState.uiReady = true
    cb({ ok = true })
end

function Template:OnClose(cb)
    self:SetUI(false)
    cb({ ok = true })
end

function Template:OnBuy(data, cb)
    if type(data) ~= "table" or type(data.item) ~= "string" or #data.item > 64 then
        cb({ ok = false })
        return
    end
    local ok, money = self:Buy(data.item, math.floor(tonumber(data.amount) or 0))
    cb({ ok = ok, money = money })
end

function Template:OnDeath()
    if self.PlayerState.uiOpen then
        self:SetUI(false)
    end
end

function Template:OnStop(resource)
    if resource ~= scriptname then
        return
    end
    for _, point in ipairs(self.Points) do
        point:remove()
    end
    for _, blip in ipairs(self.Blips) do
        if DoesBlipExist(blip) then
            RemoveBlip(blip)
        end
    end
    self.Points, self.Blips = {}, {}
    if self.PlayerState.nearShopId then
        ClearAllHelpMessages()
    end
    TriggerScreenblurFadeOut(0)
    SetNuiFocus(false, false)
end

RegisterNUICallback("uiReady", function(_, cb)
    Template:OnReady(cb)
end)

RegisterNUICallback("close", function(_, cb)
    Template:OnClose(cb)
end)

RegisterNUICallback("buy", function(data, cb)
    Template:OnBuy(data, cb)
end)

AddEventHandler("1nfx_core:onPlayerDeath", function()
    Template:OnDeath()
end)

AddEventHandler("onResourceStop", function(resource)
    Template:OnStop(resource)
end)

CreateThread(function()
    Template:Start()
end)

local scriptname = GetCurrentResourceName()

local TemplateServer = {
    ServerState = {
        throttle = {},
        inFlight = {},
    },
}

function TemplateServer:IsThrottled(src, key, limit)
    local now = GetGameTimer()
    local bucket = self.ServerState.throttle[src]
    if not bucket then
        bucket = {}
        self.ServerState.throttle[src] = bucket
    end
    if now - (bucket[key] or 0) < limit then
        return true
    end
    bucket[key] = now
    return false
end

function TemplateServer:IsNearShop(src, shop)
    local ped = GetPlayerPed(src)
    if not ped or ped == 0 then
        return false
    end
    return #(GetEntityCoords(ped) - shop.coords) <= Config.General.interact.distance + 3.0
end

function TemplateServer:FindItem(shop, itemName)
    for _, item in ipairs(shop.items) do
        if item.name == itemName then
            return item
        end
    end
    return nil
end

function TemplateServer:GetMoney(xPlayer, accountName)
    local account = xPlayer.getAccount(accountName)
    return account and account.money or 0
end

function TemplateServer:GetShop(src, shopId)
    if self:IsThrottled(src, "open", Config.General.throttle_ms.open) then
        return false, Config.Text.busy
    end
    local shop = type(shopId) == "string" and Config.Shops[shopId]
    if not shop then
        return false, Config.Text.invalid_item
    end
    if not self:IsNearShop(src, shop) then
        return false, Config.Text.too_far
    end
    local xPlayer = Core.GetPlayerFromId(src)
    if not xPlayer then
        return false, Config.Text.busy
    end
    local items = {}
    for index, item in ipairs(shop.items) do
        items[index] = {
            name = item.name,
            label = Core.GetItemLabel(item.name) or item.name,
            price = item.price,
            account = item.account,
        }
    end
    return true, {
        id = shopId,
        label = shop.label,
        items = items,
        money = self:GetMoney(xPlayer, "money"),
        maxAmount = Config.General.max_amount,
    }
end

function TemplateServer:Buy(src, payload)
    if self:IsThrottled(src, "buy", Config.General.throttle_ms.buy) then
        return false, { message = Config.Text.busy }
    end
    if type(payload) ~= "table" or type(payload.shopId) ~= "string" or type(payload.item) ~= "string" then
        return false, { message = Config.Text.invalid_item }
    end
    local amount = tonumber(payload.amount)
    if not amount or amount ~= amount then
        return false, { message = Config.Text.invalid_amount }
    end
    amount = math.floor(amount)
    if amount <= 0 or amount > Config.General.max_amount then
        return false, { message = Config.Text.invalid_amount }
    end
    local shop = Config.Shops[payload.shopId]
    local item = shop and self:FindItem(shop, payload.item)
    if not item then
        return false, { message = Config.Text.invalid_item }
    end
    if not self:IsNearShop(src, shop) then
        return false, { message = Config.Text.too_far }
    end
    local xPlayer = Core.GetPlayerFromId(src)
    if not xPlayer then
        return false, { message = Config.Text.busy }
    end
    if self.ServerState.inFlight[src] then
        return false, { message = Config.Text.busy }
    end
    self.ServerState.inFlight[src] = true
    local cost = item.price * amount
    if self:GetMoney(xPlayer, item.account) < cost then
        self.ServerState.inFlight[src] = nil
        return false, { message = Config.Text.not_enough_money }
    end
    if xPlayer.canCarryItem(item.name, amount) ~= true then
        self.ServerState.inFlight[src] = nil
        return false, { message = Config.Text.inventory_full }
    end
    xPlayer.removeAccountMoney(item.account, cost)
    xPlayer.addInventoryItem(item.name, amount)
    self.ServerState.inFlight[src] = nil
    return true, {
        message = Config.Text.purchased:format(Core.GetItemLabel(item.name) or item.name, amount),
        amount = amount,
        money = self:GetMoney(xPlayer, "money"),
    }
end

function TemplateServer:ClearPlayer(src)
    self.ServerState.throttle[src] = nil
    self.ServerState.inFlight[src] = nil
end

lib.callback.register(scriptname .. ":SV:getShop", function(source, shopId)
    local src = source
    return TemplateServer:GetShop(src, shopId)
end)

lib.callback.register(scriptname .. ":SV:buy", function(source, payload)
    local src = source
    return TemplateServer:Buy(src, payload)
end)

AddEventHandler("playerDropped", function()
    local src = source
    TemplateServer:ClearPlayer(src)
end)

--[[
    bridge/client/compat.lua

    Runtime detection of everything optional on the client: the framework, the target
    resource, the notification provider and the sound player.

    Loads FIRST among the client scripts, because every file below asks it what is installed.

    Nothing here is required. A server with none of it runs the built-in key prompt and the
    built-in native toast, which is a supported configuration and the one the resource is
    tested against most.
]]

Compat = {}

local function started(resource)
    if not resource or resource == '' then return false end
    local state = GetResourceState(resource)
    return state == 'started' or state == 'starting'
end

--- Call `fn` and return its result, or nil if it threw. The gate is Sport.callable rather than
--- a type test for the reason written there: a framework method read through an export is a
--- callable table, not a function, and a type test silently rejects it.
local function try(fn, ...)
    if not Sport.callable(fn) then return nil end
    local ok, result = pcall(fn, ...)
    if not ok then return nil end
    return result
end

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Framework
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local frameworkName
local frameworkObject

--- The client-side core object, or nil. Only three things are asked of it - the job, the
--- cuffed flag and whether the character is loaded - so the surface is deliberately tiny.
function Compat.framework()
    if frameworkName then return frameworkName, frameworkObject end

    local forced = Config.Compat.forceFramework or ''

    local candidates = {
        { resource = 'qb-core', kind = 'qb' },
        { resource = 'qbx_core', kind = 'qb' },
        { resource = 'es_extended', kind = 'esx' },
        { resource = 'ox_core', kind = 'ox' },
    }

    for _, candidate in ipairs(candidates) do
        if (forced == '' or forced == candidate.resource) and started(candidate.resource) then
            local object

            if candidate.kind == 'qb' then
                object = try(function() return exports[candidate.resource]:GetCoreObject() end)
            elseif candidate.kind == 'esx' then
                object = try(function() return exports[candidate.resource]:getSharedObject() end)
                if type(object) ~= 'table' then
                    try(function()
                        TriggerEvent('esx:getSharedObject', function(o) object = o end)
                    end)
                end
            else
                object = try(function() return exports[candidate.resource] end)
            end

            if type(object) == 'table' then
                frameworkName, frameworkObject = candidate.resource, object
                Sport.debug('client framework:', frameworkName)
                return frameworkName, frameworkObject
            end
        end
    end

    frameworkName = 'standalone'
    return frameworkName, nil
end

--[[
    Whether the local player is handcuffed.

    This is the check that actually works on ESX, where the cuffed state lives on the client
    and the server never sees it. Three sources, cheapest first:

      1. The player's own state bag, which is where every modern resource puts it.
      2. qb-core's PlayerData metadata.
      3. The animation itself - a cuffed ped is playing mp_arresting/idle, and a resource
         that tracks cuffs no other way still cannot hide that.
]]
function Compat.isCuffed()
    local state = LocalPlayer.state
    if state then
        if state.handcuffed == true or state.cuffed == true or state.isHandcuffed == true then
            return true
        end
    end

    local name, object = Compat.framework()
    if name == 'qb-core' or name == 'qbx_core' then
        local data = object and try(function() return object.Functions.GetPlayerData() end)
        local meta = type(data) == 'table' and data.metadata or nil
        if type(meta) == 'table' and (meta.ishandcuffed or meta.handcuffed) then return true end
    end

    return IsEntityPlayingAnim(PlayerPedId(), 'mp_arresting', 'idle', 3)
end

--- The local player's job name and gang, or empty strings. Used only by the requirement gate
--- on a piece of equipment; the server re-checks before it pays anything out.
function Compat.roles()
    local name, object = Compat.framework()

    --[[
        `jobType` IS PART OF THE ANSWER, and it was missing from every branch.

        The server's own requirement check reads `roles.jobType`, so `require = { job = 'leo' }` -
        a job TYPE rather than a job name - matched on the server and never on the client. The
        client then refused the session with "this is not for you" before the server was ever asked,
        which reads as the requirement being broken rather than as the client disagreeing.

        And ox_core had no branch at all: it returned the empty fallback, so every job-gated piece of
        equipment was closed to everybody on ox. ox uses GROUPS rather than jobs, so the highest
        group stands in for the job, which is the same substitution the server-side adapter makes.
    ]]
    if name == 'qb-core' or name == 'qbx_core' then
        local data = object and try(function() return object.Functions.GetPlayerData() end)
        if type(data) == 'table' then
            return {
                job = (data.job and data.job.name) or '',
                jobType = (data.job and data.job.type) or '',
                gang = (data.gang and data.gang.name) or '',
            }
        end
    elseif name == 'es_extended' then
        local data = object and try(function() return object.GetPlayerData() end)
        if type(data) == 'table' then
            -- ESX has no job type. Its grade name is the nearest thing, and it is what the
            -- server-side adapter uses, so the two sides agree.
            return {
                job = (data.job and data.job.name) or '',
                jobType = (data.job and data.job.grade_name) or '',
                gang = '',
            }
        end
    elseif name == 'ox_core' then
        local groups = object and try(function() return object.GetPlayerData().groups end)
        if type(groups) == 'table' then
            local best, bestGrade = '', -1
            for group, grade in pairs(groups) do
                if (tonumber(grade) or 0) > bestGrade then
                    best, bestGrade = group, tonumber(grade) or 0
                end
            end
            return { job = best, jobType = best, gang = '' }
        end
    end

    return { job = '', jobType = '', gang = '' }
end

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Target
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local targetName

--- 'ox_target' | 'qb-target' | 'qtarget' | 'none'. Resolved once.
function Compat.target()
    if targetName then return targetName end

    local forced = Config.Compat.forceTarget or ''
    if forced ~= '' then
        targetName = forced
        return targetName
    end

    if Config.Interaction.mode == 'key' then
        targetName = 'none'
        return targetName
    end

    for _, resource in ipairs({ 'ox_target', 'qb-target', 'qtarget' }) do
        if started(resource) then
            targetName = resource
            Sport.debug('target:', resource)
            return targetName
        end
    end

    targetName = 'none'
    return targetName
end

--- Whether the resource should use a target rather than its own key prompt.
function Compat.usesTarget()
    if Config.Interaction.mode == 'key' then return false end
    local resolved = Compat.target()
    if resolved == 'none' then return false end
    return started(resolved)
end

--[[
    Register one exercise against a list of models.

    Called once per catalogue entry at boot by client/interact.lua. `onSelect` is handed the
    entity that was targeted.

    Each target resource has its own option shape, and the differences are absorbed here so
    that client/interact.lua contains no resource names.
]]
function Compat.addTargetModels(models, option)
    local resource = Compat.target()
    if resource == 'none' or #models == 0 then return false end

    local distance = tonumber(Config.Interaction.target.distance) or 2.0
    local icon = Config.Interaction.target.icon or 'fa-solid fa-dumbbell'

    if resource == 'ox_target' then
        return try(function()
            exports.ox_target:addModel(models, { {
                name = 'vsport:' .. option.key,
                label = option.label,
                icon = icon,
                distance = distance,
                onSelect = function(data)
                    option.onSelect(data and data.entity or nil)
                end,
                canInteract = function(entity, dist)
                    return option.canInteract(entity, dist)
                end,
            } })
            return true
        end) == true
    end

    -- qb-target and qtarget share a signature. `action` gets the entity; `canInteract` gets
    -- (entity, distance, data) on qb-target and (entity) on some qtarget builds, so only the
    -- first argument is relied on.
    local exportName = resource == 'qb-target' and 'qb-target' or 'qtarget'
    return try(function()
        exports[exportName]:AddTargetModel(models, {
            options = { {
                icon = icon,
                label = option.label,
                action = function(entity)
                    option.onSelect(entity)
                end,
                canInteract = function(entity, dist)
                    return option.canInteract(entity, dist)
                end,
            } },
            distance = distance,
        })
        return true
    end) == true
end

--- Remove everything this resource registered. Called on resource stop so a restart does not
--- leave two copies of every option on the same bench.
function Compat.removeTargetModels(models, names)
    local resource = Compat.target()
    if resource == 'none' or #models == 0 then return end

    if resource == 'ox_target' then
        try(function() exports.ox_target:removeModel(models, names) end)
        return
    end

    local exportName = resource == 'qb-target' and 'qb-target' or 'qtarget'
    try(function() exports[exportName]:RemoveTargetModel(models, names) end)
end

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Notifications
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local notifyName

--- 'ox_lib' | 'qb-core' | 'esx' | 'okokNotify' | 'native'. 'native' is this resource's own
--- toast, drawn with DrawRect and DrawText.
function Compat.notifyProvider()
    if notifyName then return notifyName end

    local forced = Config.Compat.forceNotify or ''
    if forced ~= '' then
        notifyName = forced
        return notifyName
    end

    if Config.Notifications.preferOwnToast then
        notifyName = 'native'
        return notifyName
    end

    if started('ox_lib') then
        notifyName = 'ox_lib'
    elseif started('okokNotify') then
        notifyName = 'okokNotify'
    elseif started('qb-core') or started('qbx_core') then
        notifyName = 'qb-core'
    elseif started('es_extended') then
        notifyName = 'esx'
    else
        notifyName = 'native'
    end

    Sport.debug('notifications:', notifyName)
    return notifyName
end

--- Show a message. `kind` is 'primary' | 'success' | 'error'.
--- Falls through to the native toast whenever the chosen provider refuses or throws, so a
--- message is never silently lost.
function Compat.notify(message, kind, durationMs)
    if type(message) ~= 'string' or message == '' then return end

    kind = kind or 'primary'
    local duration = tonumber(durationMs) or Config.UI.toast.durationMs or 3500
    local provider = Compat.notifyProvider()
    local delivered = false

    if provider == 'ox_lib' then
        delivered = try(function()
            exports.ox_lib:notify({
                description = message,
                type = kind == 'primary' and 'inform' or kind,
                duration = duration,
            })
            return true
        end) == true

    elseif provider == 'okokNotify' then
        --[[
            okokNotify's fourth argument is its OWN type vocabulary - 'info', 'success', 'error' -
            and this resource's is 'primary', 'success', 'error'. Passing 'primary' straight through
            gave it a type it does not know, so every informational notification fell back to
            whatever its default styling is instead of reading as information.
        ]]
        local titles = { primary = 'Info', success = 'Success', error = 'Error' }
        local types = { primary = 'info', success = 'success', error = 'error' }

        delivered = try(function()
            exports['okokNotify']:Alert(titles[kind] or 'Info', message, duration,
                types[kind] or 'info')
            return true
        end) == true

    elseif provider == 'qb-core' then
        local _, object = Compat.framework()
        delivered = try(function()
            object.Functions.Notify(message, kind, duration)
            return true
        end) == true

    elseif provider == 'esx' then
        delivered = try(function()
            local _, object = Compat.framework()
            object.ShowNotification(message)
            return true
        end) == true
    end

    if not delivered then
        UI.toast(message, kind, duration)
    end
end

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Sound
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

--[[
    Every cue in Config.Minigame.sounds is a game sound, a sound file of the server's own, or both.

    A game sound is a GTA frontend sound and its soundset, `CHECKPOINT_PERFECT` in
    `HUD_MINI_GAME_SOUNDSET`. The game already has the bank loaded, so there is nothing to stream
    and nothing to ship: `PlaySoundFrontend` is the whole thing.

    A file is an .ogg the server drops into a sound resource, interact-sound by default. This
    resource has no NUI and will not grow one, so it cannot play a file itself; the sound resource
    already does exactly that, through `InteractSound_CL:PlayOnOne(file, volume)`.

    THE FILE ROUTE IS NARROW ON PURPOSE. An earlier version sent EVERY cue to interact-sound, game
    sounds included. It plays files from its own folder and takes no soundset, so the game sounds
    came out as silence, and because a fired event counted as success the native was never tried.
    Now a cue goes there only when it names a file and only while the resource is running.
    Otherwise it plays its game sound, so a missing resource costs the custom sound, never the cue.
]]

--- The running resource that plays sound files, or nil.
function Compat.soundFileResource()
    local resource = Config.Compat.soundFiles
    if type(resource) ~= 'string' or not started(resource) then return nil end
    return resource
end

--- How a cue plays right now: 'file', name, volume, resource / 'game', name, soundset / nil
--- for silence. /vsportsound prints this, so it has to be the one decision playSound acts on.
function Compat.soundRoute(cue)
    if type(cue) ~= 'table' then return nil end

    if type(cue.file) == 'string' and cue.file ~= '' then
        local resource = Compat.soundFileResource()
        if resource then
            -- interact-sound appends .ogg itself; 'hit.ogg' would ask it for hit.ogg.ogg.
            local file = cue.file:gsub('%.ogg$', '')
            local volume = Sport.clamp(cue.volume or Config.Minigame.sounds.volume, 0.0, 1.0, 0.5)
            return 'file', file, volume, resource
        end
    end

    if type(cue.name) == 'string' and cue.name ~= '' then
        return 'game', cue.name, type(cue.set) == 'string' and cue.set or ''
    end

    return nil
end

function Compat.playSound(cue)
    if not Config.Minigame.sounds.enabled then return end

    local route, name, detail = Compat.soundRoute(cue)

    if route == 'file' then
        TriggerEvent('InteractSound_CL:PlayOnOne', name, detail)
    elseif route == 'game' then
        PlaySoundFrontend(-1, name, detail, true)
    end
end

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Progress
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

--- Whether ox_lib's progress bar should be used for the rest between reps. The resource
--- draws its own otherwise, which matches the workout HUD and is one fewer dependency in the
--- hot path.
function Compat.useOxProgress()
    return Config.Compat.useOxProgress == true and started('ox_lib')
end

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Report
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

--- What /sportinfo prints. A flat table so the command can render it without knowing what is
--- in it.
function Compat.report()
    return {
        { 'Framework', Compat.framework() },
        { 'Target', Compat.target() },
        { 'Notifications', Compat.notifyProvider() },
        { 'Progress bar', Compat.useOxProgress() and 'ox_lib' or 'native' },
        { 'Sound files', Compat.soundFileResource() or 'off, game sounds only' },
        { 'Locale', Locale.current() },
        { 'Equipment', tostring(#Equipment.keys) .. ' types, ' ..
            tostring(Sport.count(Equipment.byModel)) .. ' models' },
        { 'Static spots', tostring(#(Config.Spots or {})) },
    }
end
